HERB FORMULAS
KE YIN FANG -
咳银方 - OVERCOME PSORIASIS FORMULA
English:
Overcome Psoriasis Formula
Also Known As:
sections.ACTIONS:
Rx. Rehmanniae
Sheng Di Huang
30g
Clears Heat, cools the Blood, nourishes Yin and generates fluids.
Rx. Scrophulariae
Xuan Shen
30g
Clears Heat, cools the Blood and nourishes Yin .
Sm. Cannabis
Huo Ma Ren
10g
Nourishes and moistens the Intestines, nourishes Yin and clears Heat.
Rz. Menispermi
Bei Dou Gen
10g
Clears Heat, Resolves toxicity, reduces swelling and resolves Dampness.
Rx. Sophorae Flavescentis
Ku Shen
10g
Clears Heat, dries Dampness and stops itching.
FORMULA ACTIONS
Nourishes Blood
Dispels Wind
Moistens Dryness
SYNDROMES
Blood Dryness induced psoriasis
CLINICAL MANIFESTATIONS
Small coin sized moist pale red maculae located on the scalp, body, extremities, and other areas
There is a tightly covered scale
Removing the scale reveals a light pink shining membrane
Beneath the membrane are petechiae
Progress of disease is slow
New lesions appear sporadically
Chronic patients may see it in any season
The lesions heal without scarring
There may be nail involvement with stippling or pitting of the nail plate
Rarely presents as diffuse redness of the skin covered by fine scales
Light-headedness
Pallor
T: Pale
C: Thin white
P: Thin
TREATS
Psoriasis due to Blood Dryness

HERB FORMULAS
KE YIN WAN -
咳银囊 - ANTI-PSORIASIS BOLUS
English:
Anti-Psoriasis Bolus
Also Known As:
sections.ACTIONS:
Rz. Smilacis Glabrae
Tu Fu Ling
15-60g
Relieves toxicity, eliminates Dampness and clears Damp-Heat from the skin.
With Bai Xian Pi , for skin lesions associated with Damp-Heat.
Cx. Dictamni Radicis
Bai Xian Pi
4-15g
Clears Heat, resolves Fire-toxicity, expels Wind, dries Dampness, clears Damp-Heat and stops itching.
FORMULA ACTIONS
Expels Wind
Clears Heat
Removes toxins
Relieves itching
SYNDROMES
Damp-Heat induced psoriasis
CLINICAL MANIFESTATIONS
Dark red lesions of uneven size
Lesions are covered by greasy or thick, crusty scales
Skin below scales may be moist or shows weeping exudate
Pustules may be present
Usually on palms, soles of the feet, trunk, extremities
Worse with humidity and skin folds
Chest oppression
Poor appetite
Heaviness of the lower extremities
Increased vaginal discharge
T: Normal or thick
P: Soggy and/or slippery
C: Thin, yellow and sticky
TREATS
Psoriasis due to Damp-Heat
sections.NOTES: Grind the herbs into a fine powder. Make boluses by mixing the powder with honey. A large bolus weighs 10g. A packet of small boluses weighs 20g. Administer two large boluses or one packet of small boluses each time, two - three times per day.

LIANG XIAO WAN - 涼 痚丸 - COOL WHEEZING PILLS
English:
Cool Wheezing Pills
Also Known As:
sections.ACTIONS:
Hb. Ephedrae
Ma Huang
30g
Induces sweating, releases the Exterior , disseminates and facilitates Lung Qi, calms wheezing and stops coughing .
With Xing Ren, for Wind-Cold cough and wheezing.
Rz. Aconiti Preparata
Zhi Chuan Wu
30g
Expels Wind-Dampness, d isperses Cold, w arms and activates the channels and s tops pain.
Hb. cum Rx. Asari
Xi Xin
30g
Disperses Wind-Cold and Internal Cold, warms the Lungs, transforms Phlegm and Thin Mucus and alleviates pain.
With Ma Huang, alleviates cough and wheezing due to Phlegm caused by Wind-Cold.
With Kuan Dong Hua and Zi Wan , for chronic, persistent cough.
Per. Zanthoxyli
Chuan Jiao
30g
Warms the Middle Jiao , disperses Cold and dispels Dampness.
Alumen
Ming Fan
30g
Clears Heat and e xpels Phlegm .
Fr. Gleditsiae
Zao Jiao
30g
Dispels Phlegm.
With Ming Fan, for asthma due to profuse Phlegm.
Lime-processed Rz. Pinelliae
Zhi Ban Xia
30g
Dries Dampness and transforms Phlegm.
Arisaemae cum Bile
Dan Nan Xing
30g
Clears Heat and dissolves Phlegm.
Sm. Armeniacae
Xing Ren
30g
Stops cough and calms wheezing .
With Gan Cao and Ma Huang, for cough with profuse sputum, nasal obstruction and a hoarse voice.
Rx. Glycyrrhizae
Gan Cao
30g
Moistens the Lungs, r esolves Phlegm and s tops cough .
With Ma Huang and Xing Ren, for coughing or wheezing due to Wind-Cold Attacks the Lungs.
Rx. Asteris
Zi Wan
60g
Relieves coughs and expels Phlegm .
Flos Farfare
Kuan Dong Hua
60g
Moistens the Lungs, descends Qi, stops cough and transforms Phlegm .
With Zi Wan, for cough with difficult-to-expectorate sputum.
With Xing Ren, for cough and wheezing due to Phlegm Obstruction.
FORMULA ACTIONS
Activates the Spleen
Dries Dampness
Expels Phlegm
Purges the Lungs
SYNDROMES
Cold Phlegm Obstructs the Lungs
CLINICAL MANIFESTATIONS
Cough with copious, thin, white, frothy sputum
Chest and diaphragm congestion with full feeling
Dyspnea which is worse when lying down
Panting with rales in the throat
which usually occurs when exposed to Cold
Sometimes asthma
Maybe cold upper back
A greenish-blue, stagnant facial complexion
No thirst or
A preference for warm drinks
Aversion to Cold
Maybe a slight fever
Headache
Itchy throat
Sneezing
Runny nose
Body aches
Maybe itchy skin at the beginning of the acute stage
T: Pink
C: Thick, white and greasy or sticky
P: Slippery or Floating and tight
TREATS
Bronchial asthma
Dyspnea
Chronic obstructive pulmonary disease

LIANG XUE BAI DU TANG -
凉血消风汤 - COOL THE BLOOD AND OVERCOME PATHOGENS DECOCTION
English:
Cool the Blood and Overcome Pathogens Decoction
Also Known As:
Lonicera and Gypsum Combination
sections.ACTIONS:
Fr. Forsythiae
Lian Qiao
6-30g
Clears Heat, especially in the Upper Jiao , relieves toxicity and clears Blood Heat .
With Jin Yin Hua, for initial stage Wind-Heat.
With Zhi Zi, for Heat entering the Pericardium.
With Sheng Di Huang, Xuan Shen and Shi Gao, for Heart Fire.
Fr. Gardeniae
Zhi Zi
3-12g
Clears Heat, reduces Fire, eliminates irritability , drains Damp-Heat, cools the Blood and relieves toxicity.
With Mu Dan Pi, resolves Qi Level Stagnation leading to Heat and Heat in the Blood.
With Hua Shi, for painful urinary dysfunction due to Damp-Heat in the Urinary Bladder.
With Bai Mao Gen, for epistaxis, hematemesis, or hematuria.
With Huang Lian, Huang Qin and Lian Qiao, for boils and carbuncles.
Rx. Scutellariae
Huang Qin
3-18g
Clears Heat, dries Dampness, drains Fire, detoxifies, cools the Blood and stops bleeding.
With Huang Lian, drains pathogenic Heat from the Upper and Middle Jiaos for high fever, redness, swelling and pain of the head and face, dry mouth, parched throat, ulcerations of the mouth and tongue, epistaxis, rashes and irritability in warm-febrile disease.
With Zhi Mu, for acute and chronic Lung Heat cough.
With Huang Lian and Zhi Zi, for acute febrile disease.
With Bai Mao Gen and Sheng Di Huang, for Excess Internal Heat causing reckless Blood.
With Zhi Zi, powerfully clears and drains lurking Heat from the Lungs with fever, fullness in the chest, cough with yellow sputum and epistaxis or hematemesis, treats Damp-Heat and jaundice
and sores due to Heat toxin.
Rz. Coptidis
Huang Lian
1.5-10g
Clears Heat, drains Dampness, drains Fire, resolves Fire toxicity, stops bleeding , clears Heart Fire and drains Stomach Fire.
With Huang Qin and Zhi Zi, for high fever, irritability, dry mouth and throat, and dark urine due to Fire Toxin in the three burners.
With Sheng Di Huang, for insomnia and delirium due to unremitting Heat injuring the Ying level.
With Zhi Zi and Shi Gao, for Ying Stage Heat with delirium and loss of consciousness.
With Huang Qin, Jin Yin Hua, Lian Qiao and Zhi Zi, for boils, carbuncles and furuncles.
Gypsum Fibrosum
Shi Gao
15-60g
Clears Heat in the Qi Stage, drains Fire, relieves irritability, quenches thirst, clears Excess Heat from the Lungs , clears Blazing Stomach Fire and heals eczema, burns and ulcerated sores and wounds.
With Zhi Mu, for high fever from Wind-Heat or Qi Stage Heat or Yang Ming Heat with irritability and extreme thirst.
With Xi Jiao or Shui Niu Jiao, for epidemic Damp-Heat toxin with high fever, loss of consciousness, epistaxis, and rash.
With Sheng Di Huang, for excessive Fire with injured fluids.
With Xuan Shen and Xi Jiao or Shui Niu Jiao, for Heat at the Qi and Blood Stages with skin eruptions and echymosis.
With Sheng Di Huang and Zhi Mu, for Stomach Fire.
With Mu Dan Pi, Sheng Di Huang and Xuan Shen, for Excessive Heat in the Qi and Xue Levels with continuous high fever and maculae.
Talcum

LING JIAO GOU TENG TANG -
羚角芶藤湯 - ANTELOPE HORN AND UNCARIA
DECOCTION
English:
Antelope Horn and Uncaria Decoction
Also Known As:
Ling Yang Gou Teng Tang

Pacifies the Liver, extinguishes Wind, clears Heat and toxins, anchors Yang , and stops spasms and convulsions.

With Gou Teng, Sheng Di Huang , Ju Hua and Bai Shao, for dizziness and vertigo.

explosive diarrhea and dysentery with burning pain in the anus or fitted, filthy stools and abdominal pain.

With Huang Lian and HUang Qi, for whole body Damp-Heat.

Alleviates pain

Irritability
Nervousness
Restlessness
Aversion to Heat
Desire for Cold drinks
Dark urine

Vomiting sour and bitter fluids

Pain, swelling and burning
sensations of testicles

Gu syndrome

HERB FORMULAS
LIU MO TANG - 六磨湯 - SIX MILLED-HERB DECOCTION
English:
Six Milled-Herb Decoction
Also Known As:
sections.ACTIONS:
Rx. Aucklandiae
Mu Xiang
9g
Promotes the movement of Qi , adjusts and regulates stagnant Qi in the Intestines and alleviates pain .
With Bing Lang, for Qi Stagnation in the Stomach and Intestines due to Food Stagnation with abdominal distention, fullness and distention, anorexia, aversion to the smell of food, nausea without the ability to vomit and an uncomfortable urge to defecate which is often unsuccessful.
With Bing Lang and Da Huang, for epigastric and abdominal fullness, distention, and pain with constipation.
With Wu Yao, for lower abdominal coldness and pain.
Sm. Arecae
Bing Lang
9-12g
Regulates Qi, reduces accumulations, d rains downward and u nblocks the bowels.
Lignum Aquilariae Resinatum
Chen Xiang
3-6g
Promotes movement of Qi , alleviates pain, descends Qi, regulates the Middle , dispels Cold and warms the Spleen and Stomach.
With Wu Yao, for lower abdominal pain, especially with lower abdominal Cold and tension and a stifling sensation in the chest and diaphragm with wheezing, distention and anorexia.
With Mu Xiang, relieves pain.
With Mu Xiang and Bing Lang , for constipation due to Liver Qi Stagnation.
With Wu Yao, Mu Xiang and Bing Lang , for chest and abdominal distention and pain due to Accumulation of Cold.
Rx. Linderae
Wu Yao
6-9g
Promotes movement of Qi and a lleviates pain.
Fr. Aurantii Immaturus
Zhi Shi
6-9g
Breaks up Stagnant Qi , reduces accumulation, descends Qi, u nblocks the bowels, r emoves stagnant food , transforms Phlegm, r educes distention and r esolves hardenings.
With Da Huang, for constipation and abdominal swelling due to Food Stagnation
and Qi Stagnation.
Rx. et Rz. Rhei
Da Huang
6g
Drains Heat and p urges accumulations .
FORMULA ACTIONS
Promotes the movement of Qi
Descends Rebellious Qi
Expands the chest
Disperses Stagnation
Purges accumulations
SYNDROMES
Upper Jiao Qi Stagnation with clumping in the chest and Rebellious Qi
Liver and Spleen Qi Stagnation causing constipation
CLINICAL MANIFESTATIONS
An irritable, stifling sensation in the chest and diaphragm
Labored breathing
Wheezing
Epigastric distention and fullness
Belching
Constipation
Anorexia
Hurried breathing
Abdominal distention and pain
T: Normal
C: White
P: Wiry
TREATS
Bronchial asthma
Emphysema
Gastritis
Peptic ulcer
Cholecystitis
Uterine myoma
Constipation
Abdominal fullness and distention
Chronic hepatitis
Hemorrhoids
Stiff neck
Post-surgical adhesions
Gynecomastia
Irritable bowel syndrome
Acid reflux
Cholelithiasis
Abdominal pain
COPD
Abdominal pain
Anorexia
Abdominal blockage
Stiff upper back
sections.CONTRAINDICATIONS:
Do not take long-term.
Contraindicated for those with significant Qi Deficiency with fatigue and a frail pulse.

HERB FORMULAS
LONG DAN XIE GAN TANG
- 龙胆泻肝汤 - GENTIANA
LONGDANCAO DECOCTION TO DRAIN THE LIVER
English:
Gentiana Longdancao Decoction to Drain the Liver
Also Known As:
Gentiana Combination
Decoction to Purge Liver Fire with Gentiana
sections.ACTIONS:
Rx. Gentianae
Long Dan Cao
1-9g
Drains Shi Heat from the Liver/Gallbladder, drains Liver Fire and eliminates Damp-Heat from Lower Jiao .
With Chai Hu and Huang Qin , for Liver/ Gallbladder Damp-Heat.
Rx. Scutellariae
Huang Qin
3-12g
Drains Fire, dries Dampness and calms ascending Liver Yang .
With Zhi Zi , drains Fire and eliminates Dampness.
Fr. Gardeniae
Zhi Zi
6-12g
Clears Heat, eliminates irritability and drains Damp-Heat.
With Huang Qin , drains Fire and eliminates Dampness.
Caulis Akebiae
Mu Tong
3-9g
Promotes urination.
With Che Qian Zi and Ze Xie , drains Heat from Upper Jiao and eliminates Damp-Heat from Lower Jiao through the urine.
Sm. Plantaginis
Che Qian Zi
3-15g
Promotes urination and clears Heat.
Rz. Alismatis
Ze Xie
3-12g
Promotes urination and clears Damp Heat.
Rx. Bupleuri
Chai Hu
3-12g
Disperses Heat due to Liver/Gallbladder Qi Stagnation and focuses the actions of the formula on Liver/Gallbladder. (Omitted in some versions).
With Huang Qin , clears Shao Yang Heat.
With Gan Cao , for hepatitis and upper right quadrant pain.
Rx. Rehmanniae
Sheng Di Huang
5-15g
Nourishes Yin and clears Heat.
With Dang Gui , protects Yin and Blood.
Extremitas Radicis Angelicae Sinensis
Dang Gui Wei
5-12g
Nourishes Blood without causing Stasis.
With Sheng Di Huang , protects Yin and Blood
Rx. Glycyrrhizae
Gan Cao
1-6g
Harmonizes the Middle Jiao and regulates other herbs.

Drains Excess Fire from the Liver and Gallbladder
Clears and Drains Damp-Heat from the Lower Jiao
Clears Damp-Heat from the San Jiao

Damp-Heat in the Liver and Gallbladder

Acute onset

HERB FORMULAS
MA HUANG JIA ZHU TANG -
麻黄加术汤 - EPHEDRA DECOCTION PLUS ATRACTYLODES
English:
Ephedra Decoction plus Atractylodes
Also Known As:
sections.ACTIONS:
Hb. Ephedrae
Ma Huang
5-9g
Strongly promotes diaphoresis, relieves the Exterior, disperses Lung Qi, promotes urination and expels Cold.
With Gui Zhi , for Wind-Cold Excess with fever, chills and anhidrosis and Wind-Cold-Damp Bi .
With Xing Ren , for cough and wheezing due to Wind-Cold Attacks the Lungs.
Rz. Atractylodis Macrocephalae
Bai Zhu
5-12g
Tonifies the Spleen, augments Qi, dries Dampness, promotes water metabolism, stabilizes the exterior and stops sweating.
Ram. Cinnamomi
Gui Zhi
4-9g
Promotes diaphoresis, warms the channels, disperses Cold, releases the exterior, assists the Yang, a djusts the Ying and Wei, warms and facilitates the flow of Qi through the channels and collaterals and Blood through the vessels and releases the muscle layer .
With Zhi Gan Cao, for palpitations and shortness of breath due to injured Yang of the chest.
Sm. Armeniacae
Xing Ren
5-12g
Disperses Lung Qi , resolves Phlegm and stops cough and wheezing.
With Ma Huang and Zhi Gan Cao, for cough with profuse sputum, nasal obstruction and a hoarse voice.
Rx. Glycyrrhizae Preparata
Zhi Gan Cao
1-6g

With Ma Huang and Xing Ren , for Wind-Cold Attacks the Lungs with coughing and/ or wheezing.

Contraindicated for those with Lin Syndrome.

Ephedra Wash

Huang Lian
30g

Fr. Cnidii
She Chuang Zi
30g
Dries Dampness, k ills parasites and s tops itching topically.

Ai Ye
15g

Wu Mei

DECOCTION

Modified Ophiopogonis, Schisandra and Rehmannia Decoction
Also Known As:

Tub. Ophiopogonis
Mai Men Dong
10g
Moistens the Lungs, stops cough, nourishes Stomach Yin , generates fluids, clears the Heart, eliminates irritability and moistens the Intestines.
Raw Rx. Rehmanniae

10g

10g

4.5g

With Fu Ling, promotes urination.

Fu Ling
4.5g
Promotes urination, strengthens the Spleen and drains Dampness.

15g

15g

15g

Gou Ji
15g

With Dang Gui , for long term disease leading to lower extremity swelling.

Gou Teng
15g

Dang Gui
12g

Dan Shen
12g
Activates Blood, creaks up Blood Stasis, clears Heat, cools and nourishes the Blood, reduces abdominal swellings and generates flesh.
With Dang Gui, for irregular menstruation and lochioschesis.
With Mu Dan Pi and Sheng Di Huang , for Ying Stage Heat with high fever, irritability, hemoptysis, epistaxis, and subcutaneous bleeding.

Nourishes the Liver
Enriches the Kidney.

Psoriasis due to Liver and Kidney Deficiencies

Lesions are pale red and are covered by a thin layer of grayish white scales
Low back soreness
Weak extremities
Joint pain
Tinnitus
Light-headedness
T: Thick with teeth marks
C: Thin
P: Soggy and thin
TREATS
Psoriasis due to Liver and Kidney Deficiency

HERB FORMULAS
MULTIPLE SCLEROSIS #1
English:
Also Known As:
sections.ACTIONS:
Rx. Rehmanniae Preparata
Shu Di Huang
9-30g
Nourishes Yin , Jing and Blood.
With Shan Zhu Yu, nourishes Kidney Yin and secures Jing, while restraining urination and sweating.
Rx. Ophiopogonis
Mai Men Dong
6-15g
Moistens the Lung, nourishes Stomach Yin , generates Fluids, clears the Heart, eliminates irritability, moistens Intestines and resolves Phlegm.
Hb. Cistanches
Rou Cong Rong
9-21g
Tonifies the Kidneys, strengthens Yang and benefits Jing and marrow.
Rx. Morindae
Ba Ji Tian
6-15g
Tonifies the Kidneys, strengthens Yang , strengthens sinews and bones, disperses Wind and expels Cold-Damp.
Fr. Corni
Shan Zhu Yu
3-12g
Stabilizes the Kidneys, astringes Jing , nourishes Liver and Kidney Yin and tonifies Kidney Yang .
With Wu Wei Zi, for spermatorrhea, abnormal sweating, palpitations and shortness of breath due to Yin and Yang Deficiencies of the Liver and Kidneys.
Fr. Schisandrae
Wu Wei Zi
6-9g
Tonifies Qi , nourishes Kidney Yin , astringes Jing , tonifies the Heart and calms the Spirit.
Rx. Polygalae
Yuan Zhi
3-9g
Calms the Spirit, sedates the Heart, expels Phlegm, opens the Orifices and clears the channel joining the Heart and Kidneys.
Rz. Acori Tatarinowii
Shi Chang Pu
3-10g
Harmonizes the Middle Jiao , transforms turbid Dampness, opens the Orifices, vaporizes Phlegm, disperses Wind, calms the Spirit, and alleviates Wind-Damp Bi .
With Yuan Zhi , calms the Spirit and open orifices
Fol. Eriobotryae
Pi Pa Ye
4-15g
Descends Lung Qi , transforms Phlegm, clears Lung Heat, harmonizes the Stomach, descends Stomach Qi and clears Stomach Heat.
FORMULA ACTIONS
Nourishes and Astringes Jing and Yin
Tonifies Yang
SYNDROMES
Jing Insufficiency
Yin Deficiency
Yang Deficiency
Kidney Yang Deficiency
CLINICAL MANIFESTATIONS
Feeling chilled
Withdrawn, subdued behavior
Aversion to Cold
Tinnitus
Cold limbs
Impotence
Spermatorrhea,
Premature ejaculation
General debility
Pale face
Low libido
Urinary frequency with abundant, clear urine
Female infertility ("uterus cold and infertile")
Oliguria with edema
Maybe nocturia
Maybe anorexia
Lassitude
Dizziness
Maybe chronic diarrhea or "cock crow" diarrhea
Maybe loose stools
In adults :
Hair loss
Graying or whitening of hair
Weak sexual function
Atrophy and weakness of feet with difficulty walking
Poor memory
Senility (premature or mature)
Brittle bones
Gradual deterioration of hearing
In children :
Retardation in mental and/or physical development
Failure to thrive
Late or incomplete closing of fontanel
Poor bone development,
Brittle bones
T: Pale and swollen
C: Thin and white
P: Deep and thready - maybe slow
TREATS
Multiple sclerosis

HERB FORMULAS
MULTIPLE SCLEROSIS #2
English:
Also Known As:
sections.ACTIONS:
Carapax Trionycis
Bie Jia
9-30g
Nourishes Yin , anchors Yang and activates Blood.
Rx. Rehmanniae
Shu Di Huang
9-30g
Nourishes Yin , Jing and Blood.
With Dang Gui, for Blood Deficiency marked by dizziness, palpitations, insomnia and menstrual dysfunction.
With Bai Shao and Dang Gui , for Blood Deficiency.
Cx. Eucommiae
Du Zhong
6-15g
Tonifies the Kidneys and Liver, strengthens sinews and bones, and smoothes the flow of Qi and Blood.
With Xu Duan, tonifies the Liver and Kidneys, streng-thens the lower back and secures the Chong and Ren channels to treat aching in the lower back and knees, weakness of the legs which makes walking difficult and especially threatened miscarriage due to instability of the Chong and Ren channels.
Rx. Dipsaci
Xu Duan
6-21g
Strengthens the sinews and bones, tonifies the Liver and Kidneys, activates the Blood and alleviates pain.
With Du Zhong and Niu Xi, for deficient Kidneys or Cold-Damp Bi causing low back and leg pain and weakness, and contracture of the leg muscles.
Sm. Cuscutae
Tu Si Zi
9-15g
Tonifies the Kidneys nourishes Yin , nourishes the Kidneys and Liver, tonifies Yang and benefits the Kidneys, Spleen and marrow.
With Du Zhong, enriches and tonifies the Kidneys and Liver, astringes Jing, nourishes Kidney Yin , brightens the eyes and encourages the movement of Primal Yang to treat spermatorrhea, premature ejaculation and lower back pain from Kidney Deficiency.
Rz. Atractylodis Macrocephalae
Bai Zhu
3-12g
Tonifies the Spleen, tonifies Qi , dries Dampness and stabilizes Wei Qi .
With Fu Ling and gan Cao, for Spleen and Stomach Qi Deficiencies.
Poriae
Fu Ling
9-18
Promotes urination, resolves Dampness, tonifies the Spleen, harmonizes the Middle Jiao transforms Phlegm, calms the Heart and Spirit and soothes nerves.
With Bai Zhu , tonifies the Spleen and resolves Dampness.
With Gan Cao, for Spleen and Heart Deficiencies causing facial edema, palpitations, and shortness of breath.
Rx. Glycyrrhizae
Gan Cao
2-12g
Tonifies Spleen Qi , clears Heat, moderates spasms, alleviates pain and moderates and harmonizes the harsh properties of other herbs.
With Bai Shao , for spasms of the calf.
Rx. Angelicae Sinensis
Dang Gui
3-15g
Tonifies, activates and harmonizes Blood, disperses Cold, reduces swelling and alleviates pain.
With Huang Qi , for Blood Deficiency.
With Bai Shao , regulates and harmonizes Blood.
With Gan Cao , moderates spasms.
With Shu Di Huang, for Heat symptoms due to Yin Deficiency and Devastated Blood.
Rx. Paeoniae Alba
Bai Shao
6-30g
Calms Liver Yang , nourishes Blood, astringes Yin and alleviates pain.
With Dang Gui , tonifies Yin and Blood.
With Dang Gu i and Shu Di Huang , for Blood Deficiency or Blood Stasis.
With Gan Cao, regulates the relationship between the Liver and Spleen and nourishes the sinews.
Rx. Achyranthis Bidentatae
Niu Xi
6-15g
Activates the Blood, strengthens sinews and bones, nourishes the Liver and Kidneys and benefits the joints.
With Du Zhong , for low back and leg pain and weakness due to Bi pain or Kidney Deficiency.
Cx. Phellodendri
Huang Bai
3-12g
Drains Damp-Heat from Lower Jiao and drains Kidney Fire.
With Zhi Mu, for Lower Jiao Damp-Heat.
With Dang Gui and Niu Xi, for sore and weak low back and legs.
Rz. Anemarrhenae
Zhi Mu
6-12
Clears Heat, drains Fire, nourishes Yin , moistens Dryness and generates Fluids.
With Huang Bai , clears Heat and drains Fire. for Yin Deficiency with night sweats, dizziness and vertigo.
With Bie Jia, for steaming bone disorder.
With Huang Bai and Shu Di Huang, for Yin Deficiency with Empty Fire.
Per. Citri Reticulatae
Chen Pi
3-9g
Regulates and descends Qi , tonifies the Spleen, transforms Phlegm and helps prevent stagnation from tonic herbs.
With Bai Zhu, for anorexia and other symptoms of Damp-Obstruction due to Spleen Deficiency.
Cornu Cervi Pantotrichum
Lu Rong
1-3g
Tonifies the Kidneys, tonifies Qi and Yang , tonifies the DU Channel, nourishes Jing and Blood, strengthens sinews and bones, benefits marrow, regulates the Chong and Ren channels and stabilizes the Dai Channel.
With Shu Di Huang , for impotence and spermatorrhea (men) and infertility and thin vaginal discharge (women) due to Kidney Deficiency Cold and physical retardation in children.
Rx. Astragali
Huang Qi
9-60g
Tonifies Spleen Qi , generates Fluids, raises Spleen Yang , tonifies Wei Qi and nourishes the Blood.
With Bai Zhu , for Spleen Qi Deficiency.
FORMULA ACTIONS
Nourishes and Astringes Jing
Nourishes the Blood
Tonifies Qi
SYNDROMES
Jing Insufficiency
Qi Deficiency
Blood Deficiency
CLINICAL MANIFESTATIONS
Qi Deficiency :
Lethargy
Fatigue
Symptoms worse with exertion
Symptoms better with rest
Shortness of breath with little exertion Laconic speech
Shiny, pale complexion
Reduced appetite
Maybe loose stools
Prolapse
Bleeding
Incontinence
Profuse sweating
Maybe soft voice
Maybe a chronic cough with generalized weakness
T: Pale
C: Thin white
P: Deep and Weak
Blood Deficiency :
Pale face, lips and nails
Dizziness
Palpitations
Scanty menses
Amenorrhea
Numbness of extremities
Insomnia
T: Pale
C: White
P: Thready and Weak
Kidney Jing Deficiency :
Dizziness
Tinnitus
Low back and knees weak and aching
In adults :
Hair loss
Graying or whitening of hair.
Weak sexual function
Atrophy and weakness of the feet with difficulty walking
Poor memory
Senility (premature or mature)
Brittle bones
Gradual deterioration of hearing
In children :
Retardation in mental and/or physical development
Failure to thrive
Late or incomplete closing of the fontanel Poor bone development
Brittle bones
TREATS
Multiple sclerosis

English:
Also Known As:
sections.ACTIONS:
Rx. Bupleuri Marginati
Zhu Ye Suan Cao
300g
Liver pain, sun lift depression, Cold and fever, Cold and Heat exchanges, Spleen Jiuxie , hanging off the disease.
Hb. Xanthii
Cang Er Cao
300g
Dispels Wind and clears Heat toxins.
Hb. Solani Nigri
Long Kui
30g
Clears Heat, resolves toxicity, invigorates the Blood and reduces swellings.
Rz. Fagopyrum Cymosum
Ye Qiao Mai Gen
250g
A decoction of the roots is used in the treatment of insect bites, dysmenorrhea, inflammation, lumbago, snakebite and traumatic injuries.
Rz. Paridis
Chong Lou
150g
Extinguishes Liver Wind, drains Heat, r elieves Fire toxicity, r educes swelling and inflammation and s tops pain .
Rx. Trichosanthis
Tian Hua Fen
15g
Drains Heat, generates Fluids, clears and drains Lung Heat, transforms Phlegm, moistens Lung Dryness, relieves toxicity, expels pus and r educes swelling.
FORMULA ACTIONS
Clears Heat
Resolves toxicity
Invigorates the Blood
Reduces swellings
SYNDROMES
Toxic Heat with Blood stagnation
CLINICAL MANIFESTATIONS
Epistaxis, usually a small amount of Blood (initial stage)
Nasal obstruction (early stage)
Tumor in the nose
Tinnitus
Deafness
Masses of the neck
Vernet's syndrome
Platoplegia
Asymmetry of the palate
Disappearance of the mouth opening
Migraines
Dysphagia
Choking sensation while drinking
Hoarseness
Exophthalmos
Blindness
Usually asymptomatic at the early stage
The tumor may appear as a Cauliflower-like nodule or ulceration on the nasopharynx or as membrane erosion of abnormal color
If the tumor infiltrates to the submucosal layer, the surface of the membrane will be smooth and the nasopharynx will be depressed
Cranial nerve involvement is reflected by:
Paralysis of the eyeball
Facial hypothesia or hypoalgesia
Difficulty opening the mouth
Inclination of the tongue when it protrudes
Aphasia
Paralysis of the soft palate
Disappearance of the gullet response
TREATS
Nasopharyngeal cancer

Also Known As:

Fr. Aurantii

Natrii Sulfas

With Da Huang, for constipation.

10g
Drains Fire, r elieves toxicity, e liminates Dampness, r esolves Lumps (reduces swelling), r elieves pain and generates flesh.

FORMULA ACTIONS
Clears Heat
Resolves toxicity
Drains abscesses and swellings
Releases the Exterior
SYNDROMES
Toxic Heat
CLINICAL MANIFESTATIONS
Epistaxis, usually a small amount of Blood (initial stage)
Nasal obstruction (early stage)
Tumor in the nose
Tinnitus
Deafness
Masses of the neck
Vernet's syndrome
Platoplegia
Asymmetry of the palate
Disappearance of the mouth opening
Migraines
Dysphagia
Choking sensation while drinking
Hoarseness
Exophthalmos
Blindness
Usually asymptomatic at the early stage

Paralysis of the eyeball
Facial hypothesia or hypoalgesia
Difficulty opening the mouth
Inclination of the tongue when it protrudes
Aphasia
Paralysis of the soft palate
Disappearance of the gullet response
TREATS
Nasopharyngeal cancer

3-15g

6-16g

4.5-15g

Rz. Cyperi
Xiang Fu
6-14g
Spreads and regulates Liver Qi, regulates menstruation and a lleviates pain .
prepared and carbonized Rx. et Rz. Rhei

3-15g
Stops bleeding.
Pollen Typhae
Pu Huang
3-12g
Invigorates the Blood,
d ispels

Dan Shen
3-15g

0.3-0.6g

Invigorates the Blood
Breaks up Stagnation
Warms the channels
Unblocks Yang

Kidney Yang Deficiency with Blood Stagnation (with lower abdominal pain and incessant bleeding)
Deficiency Cold of the Chong and Ren (with lower abdominal pain and incessant bleeding)
CLINICAL MANIFESTATIONS
The origin of this pattern is either a constitutional
weakness, or a history of surgical procedures
Pain in the lower abdomen and pelvic region
Heavy and/or irregular periods
Spotting between periods or before periods or
Incessant bleeding
Infertility
Difficulty conceiving
Pain during sexual intercourse
Abdominal swelling
Painful bowel movements, especially during menstruation
Bleeding from the rectum during menstruation
Lower abdominal pain during menstruation
Painful urination during menstruation
Low back pain
Sometimes no symptoms at all
Abdominal tenderness
A feeling of pressure and pain during or after periods
Soreness of the back, legs, and hips
Dizziness
Scanty periods or spotting
Blood clots with periods
Other symptoms may include :
Headaches
Low grade fevers
Depression
Hypoglycemia
Anxiety

C: Thin and white

Endometriosis

HERB FORMULAS
NIU XI SAN - 牛膝散 - ACHYRANTHIS POWDER
English:
Achyranthis Powder
Also Known As:
sections.ACTIONS:
Rx. Achyranthis Bidentatae
Niu Xi
9-30g
Invigorates the Blood and e xpels Blood Stasis .
Ram. Cinnamomi
Gui Zhi
9-30g
Warms and facilitates the flow of Qi through the channels and collaterals and Blood through the vessels to relieve pain.
With Tao Ren and Mu Dan Pi, for gynecological discomfort due to Blood Stasis.
With Dang Gui and Chuan Xiong, for irregular menstruation due to Yang Deficiency with Cold Stagnation.
Rx. Paeoniae Rubra
Chi Shao
6-15g
Invigorates the Blood, dispels Blood Stasis, clears Heat, cools the Blood and relieves pain.
With Chuan Xiong and Dang Gui, for Blood-Stasis induced gynecological disorders such as immobile abdominal masses and amenorrhea with abdominal pain.
With Tao Ren, for Blood Stasis induced menstrual disorders, especially those characterized by early period, excessive bleeding and thick purple clots.
With Mu Dan Pi, for Blood Stasis disorders.
Rx. Angelicae Sinensis
Dang Gui
4-15g
Tonifies, invigorates and harmonizes the Blood.
With Dang Gui, harmonizes, nourishes and invigorates the Blood and disperses Blood Stasis.
Rx. Aucklandiae
Mu Xiang
6-15g
Promotes the movement of Qi and a lleviates pain.
Cx. Moutan
Mu Dan Pi
6-15g
Invigorates the Blood, dispels Blood Stasis, clears Heat and cools and harmonizes the Blood.
With Chi Shao, for irregular menstruation due to Heat and obstruction from Blood Deficiency.
With Gui Zhi, for chest and abdominal pain due to Blood Stagnation.
Rz. Corydalis
Yan Hu Suo
6-15g
Invigorates the Blood, circulates Qi and stops pain.
With Chuan Xiong, for body aches and headaches due to Blood Stagnation.
With Gui Zhi and Dang Gui, for dysmenorrhea due to Cold in the Blood.
Rz. Chuanxiong
Chuan Xiong
6-15g
Invigorates the Blood, promotes the movement of Qi and a lleviates pain.
With Dang Gui, for Blood Deficiency causing menstrual problems including dysmenorrhea, scanty menses and amenorrhea.
Sm. Persicae
Tao Ren
6-15g
Breaks up Blood Stasis and invigorates Blood circulation .
FORMULA ACTIONS
Invigorates the Blood
Disperses Stasis
Moves Qi in the abdomen
Regulates menstruation
SYNDROMES
Blood Stagnation
CLINICAL MANIFESTATIONS
Scanty menstruation
Irregular menstruation
Palpable masses that may or may not be painful
Lower abdominal pain without palpable masses which is worse with pressure
Lower abdominal distention
Lower back pain
Lower abdominal distention during menstruation
Maybe distention along the flanks
Frequent menstruation (3-5 timer per month)
Spotting
Dark purple menstrual Blood (usually with clots)
Abnormal uterine bleeding with abdominal soreness and
pain
Aversion to Cold
Depression
Cold extremities
White vaginal discharge
T: Pale or With purple spots
C: White
P: Choppy
TREATS
Hypomenorrhea

NODULAR VASCULITIS #1
English:
Also Known As:
sections.ACTIONS:
Rx. Astragali
Huang Qi
9-30g
Tonifies Qi and Blood, strengthens the Spleen, raises the Yang Qi of the Spleen and Stomach and relieves numbness and pain.
Cx. Cinnamomi
Rou Gui
1.5-5g
Warms the Kidneys, Spleen and Heart, strengthens the Yang and Ming Men Fire, disperses deep Cold, w arms the channels, u nblocks the channels and vessels, a lleviates pain and assists the generation of Qi and Blood .
Rx. Salviae Miltiorrhizae
Dan Shen
3-15g
Invigorates, c ools and nourishes the Blood, d ispels Blood Stasis, clears Heat, soothes irritability and calms the Spirit .
Caul. Spatholobi
Ji Xue Teng
9-20g
Invigorates and tonifies the Blood, invigorates the channels and relaxes the sinews.
Rx. Paeoniae Rubra
Chi Shao
4.5-15g
Invigorates and cools the Blood, dispels Blood Stasis, relieves pain, clears Heat, c lears Liver Fire and brightens the eyes .
Sp. Prunellae
Xia Ku Cao
6-18g
Clears Liver Fire, brightens the eyes , clears Hot Phlegm and dissipates nodules.
Rz. Chuanxiong
Chuan Xiong
3-10g
Invigorates the Blood and promotes the movement of Qi.
Rx. Scrophulariae
Xuan Shen
7-30g
Clears Heat, cools the Blood, nourishes Yin and Relieves toxicity.
Sm. Coicis
Yi Yi Ren
9-30g
Strengthens the Spleen , resolves Dampness, expels Wind-Dampness, relieves pain and Clears Damp-Heat .
Per. Citri Reticulatae
Chen Pi
3-9g
Regulates Qi , adjusts the Middle, r elieves the diaphragm , dries Dampness and t ransforms Phlegm.
Rx. Glycyrrhizae
Gan Cao
3-6g
Tonifies the Spleen, augments Qi , clears Heat, r elieves Fire toxicity and moderates and harmonizes the harsh properties of other herbs .
FORMULA ACTIONS
Clears Heat
Cools the Blood
Invigorates the Blood
Relieves Dampness
Tonifies Qi and Blood
SYNDROMES
Qi and Blood Deficiency with Blood Heat and/or Damp-Heat Leading to Blood Stagnation
CLINICAL MANIFESTATIONS
Chronic inflammatory nodules of the legs
Mainly affects women aged 30 to 60
Men are less often affected
The nodules or lumps are usually found on the backs of the lower legs but they may also occur on the thighs and arms
One or both legs may be involved
Lesions range in size from small bumps to large plaques
They may be more easily seen than felt
Aching legs
Red-purple discoloration
Cool skin
Varicose veins
There can be acute inflammation or ulceration
Nodules may continue to erupt at irregular intervals over months or years
TREATS
Nodular vasculitis

Warm the Liver Decoction
Also Known As:
Decoction for Warming the Liver Channel
sections.ACTIONS:

Dang Gui
6-10g
Invigorates and tonifies Liver Blood, disperses Cold and alleviates pain.
With Fu Ling , strengthens Qi and Blood while promoting their movement.
Fr. Lycii
Gou Qi Zi
9-10g
Nourishes and tonifies The Liver and Kidneys, and nourishes Blood and Yin .
With Rou Gui , warms and tonifies the Liver and Kidneys.

Warms the Kidneys, disperses Cold, spreads Liver Qi and alleviates pain.
With Rou Gui and Wu Yao , for sharp, localized lower abdominal pain that is aggravated by Cold.
Cx. Cinnamomi
Rou Gui
3-6g
Warms the Kidneys, strengthens Ming Men Fire, disperses deep Cold and warms the channels.
Rx. Linderae
Wu Yao
6g

With Chen Xiang , enhances the actions of Xiao Hui Xiang by moving Qi and alleviating Lower Jiao pain.
With Rou Gui, for abdominal pain, especially sensations of Cold and pain in the lower abdomen.
With Dang Gui, disperses Cold and stops pain, for abdominal pain due to External Cold.
Lignum Aquilariae
Chen Xiang
3g
Moves and descends Qi , warms the Kidneys and alleviates pain.

With Rou Gui, for Spleen and Stomach Deficiency Cold with epigastric, abdominal and hypochondriac Cold pain.
With Xiao Hui Xian, for Spleen and Stomach Deficiency Cold with epigastric, abdominal and hypochondriac Cold pain.
With Mu Xiang, for Rebellious Middle Jiao Qi with belching, hiccup, nausea and vomiting, epigastric and abdominal distention stifling sensation in the epigastrium and diarrhea.

(Mu Xiang)
(3g)

Poriae
Fu Ling

Rz. Zingiberis Recens
Sheng Jiang
3-6g
Disperses Cold and harmonizes the Stomach.

Warms the Liver and Kidneys
Promotes Qi movement
Dispels Cold
Alleviates pain

Small Intestine Qi Pain
Cold Stagnation in the Liver Channel
Cold type hernia

Sharp, localized lower abdominal pain
Pain aggravated by Cold
Post menstrual pain
Swelling, distention and pain of scrotum
May be nausea and anorexia

English:
Borax and Persimmon Frost Pill
Also Known As:
sections.ACTIONS:
Borax

30g
Resolves toxicity, reduces swellings, clears Heat, dries Dampness, d issolves Phlegm and t ransforms stones .

20g

Clears Heat
Nourishes Yin
Softens hardness

Esophageal cancer due to Toxic Heat with a hot diaphragm and a sore throat

Progressive dysphagia

HERB FORMULAS
PING YING FU FANG - 平 瘿复方 - FORMULA TO DISSOLVE GOITER
English:
Formula to Dissolve Goiter
Also Known As:
sections.ACTIONS:
Concha Ostreae
Mu Li
20g
Calms the Liver, benefits Yin , anchors Floating Yang, softens hardness and dissipates nodules .
Spica Prunellae
Xia Ku Cao
15g
Clears Liver Fire, clears Hot Phlegm, dissipates nodules and treats hypertension .
With Zhe Bei Mu, cools and relieves toxicity to disperse and transform Phlegm and treat goiter, scrofula and swollen or inflamed lymph glands.
With Dang Gui, Bai Shao and Xuan Shen, for Liver Fire with Blood Deficiency.
Concha Arcae
Wa Leng Zi
12g
Invigorates the Blood, dissolves Phlegm, resolves Stagnation, softens hardness and dissipates nodules.
With Zhe Bei Mu and Xia Ku Cao, for scrofula due to Phlegm-Fire.
Rx. Scrophulariae
Xuan Shen
12g
Clears Heat, cools the Blood, nourishes Yin, softens hardness
and dissipates nodules.
With Mu Li and Zhe Bei Mu, for scrofula, goiter, and other nodules due to Phlegm.
Rx. Paeoniae Alba
Bai Shao
12g
Nourishes the Blood , astringes Yin and calms Liver Yang and Liver Wind.
With Dang Gui, nourishes Yin and Blood.
Cx. Moutan
Mu Dan Pi
12g
Clears Deficiency Fire, invigorates the Blood and dispels Blood Stasis .
With Sheng Di Huang, for Kidney Yin Deficiency with steaming bones.
Rx. Rehmanniae
Sheng Di Huang
12g
Clears Heat, cools the Blood, nourishes Yin and generates fluids.
With Bai Shao, for Blood Deficiency Heat.
With Xuan Shen, for Kidney Yin Deficiency with Fire Blazing with soreness
and swelling in the throat, dry mouth and a parched tongue.
Rx. Angelicae Sinensis
Dang Gui
12g
Tonifies, invigorates and harmonizes the Blood, reduces swelling, expels pus, generates flesh and alleviates pain.
With Bai Shao, regulates and harmonizes Qi and Blood.
Poria
Fu Ling
12g
Promotes urination, leaches out Dampness and strengthens the Spleen .
Fr. Corni
Shan Zhu Yu
9g
Stabilizes the Kidneys, astringes Jing and Body Fluids , tonifies Liver and Kidney Yin and s trengthens Kidney Yang.
Bul. Fritillariae Thunbergii
Zhe Bei Mu
9g
Clears Heat, transforms Phlegm and dissipates nodules .
With Xuan Shen, Mu Li and Xia Ku Cao, for scrofula due to Phlegm-Fire with swelling and pain at multiple sites.
with Xuan Shen and Mu Li, for nodules without abscess.
Per. Citri Reticulatae Viride
Qing Pi
9g
Spreads Liver Qi, breaks up Stagnant Qi , dries Dampness and t ransforms Phlegm .
With San Leng and E Zhu, for masses where prolonged Qi Stagnation has led to Blood Stagnation.
Per. Citri Reticulatae
Chen Pi
9g
Regulates Qi , adjusts the Middle, r elieves the diaphragm, dries Dampness, transforms Phlegm and descends Qi .
With Qing Pi, for flank pain and chest and abdominal distention due to Liver Qi Stagnation.
Rz. Sparganii
San Leng
9g
Forcefully breaks up Blood Stasis, regulates Qi, dissolves accumulations and alleviates pain.
Rz. Curcumae
E Zhu
9g
Invigorates
Blood circulation, dispels Blood Stasis, regulates Qi and
alleviates pain .
With Qing Pi, for Stagnant Qi with chest and abdominal fullness and pain.
With San Leng, for Qi and Blood Stagnation with clumping and accumulation.
FORMULA ACTIONS
Nourishes Kidney and Liver Yin
Nourishes Blood
Clears Heat
Cools Blood
Clears Deficiency Fire
Invigorates Blood and Qi
Dissipates accumulations
Pacifies the Heart
Strengthens the Spleen
SYNDROMES
Heart and Liver Yin Deficiency with Phlegm
Yin and Blood Deficiency with Qi and Blood Stagnation with nodulations
CLINICAL MANIFESTATIONS
Goiter with nodulations
The lump is small or large and relatively soft with a slow onset
Palpitations
Insomnia
Afternoon fever
Night sweats
Hand tremors
Constipation
Urine short and red
Heightened libido
Blurred vision
Pain that is fixed, stabbing and /or severe or
Dry eyes
Blurred vision
Tiredness
T: Red
C: Little or none
P: Floating and empty, relatively overflowing on left cun
TREATS
Hyperthyroidism
Scrofula
Goiter

DECOCTION TO CLEAR THE LUNG
English:
Eriobotrya Decoction to Clear the Lung
Also Known As:
Loquat Decoction to Clear the Lung
Decoction of Folium Eriobotrya for Removing Heat from the Lung
sections.ACTIONS:
Fol. Eriobotrya
Pi Pa Ye

With Huang Lian, Zhi Zi and Sang Bai Pi, for cough with copious yellow Phlegm due to Lung Heat.

Sang Bai Pi
6-9g
Drains Heat from the Lungs, stops cough and calms wheezing.
Rz. Coptidis
Huang Lian
3-9g
Clears Heat, drains Dampness, drains Fire, resolves Fire toxicity, clears Heat and stops bleeding.
Cx. Phellodendri
Huang Bai
3g
Drains Damp-Heat especially from the Lower Jiao, drains Fire and relieves Fire toxicity.
Rx. Ginseng
Ren Shen
1g
Tonifies Qi, generates Body Fluids and s tops thirst .
Rx. Glycyrrhizae
Gan Cao
1g
Moistens the Lungs, r esolves Phlegm, s tops cough , clears Heat, r elieves Fire toxicity and moderates and harmonizes the harsh properties of other herbs.
FORMULA ACTIONS
Cool the Blood
Eliminate Dampness
Invigorate the Blood
Clear Lung Heat
SYNDROMES
Damp-Heat in the Lungs
Lung Heat
Blood Heat
CLINICAL MANIFESTATIONS
Redness of the bulb of the nose
The redness blanches upon pressure
Red papules, tubercles and acne and inflammatory infiltration around them
Whiteheads or blackheads
Dry nose
Dry mouth
Burning sensation
Constipation
Dry stool
T: Red or Red tip
C: Thin and yellow
P: Wiry and slippery or Slippery and rapid
TREATS
Acne
Rosacea

English:
Eriobotrya Clear the Lungs Decoction
Also Known As:
sections.ACTIONS:
Fol. Eriobotryae
Pi Pa Ye
9g
Transforms Phlegm, clears Lung Heat and descends Lung Qi .
With Xing Ren, for Lung Heat induced non-productive cough, or cough with viscous sputum that is difficult to expectorate, with chest pain and a dry throat.
Sm. Armeniacae
Xing Ren
9g
Stops cough and calms wheezing .
Spora Lygodii
Hai Jin Sha
9g
Clears Heat, promotes urination, unblocks painful urinary dysfunction and expels stones .
Faeces Bombycis
Can Sha
9g
Harmonizes the Stomach and transforms turbid Dampness .
Sm. Plantaginis
Che Qian Zi
9g
Promotes urination, clears Damp-Heat, clears the Lungs, expels Phlegm and stops cough.
With Ze Xie, for Lin Syndrome, edema and distention.
Rz. Alismatis
Ze Xie
9g
Promotes urination, leaches out Dampness and settles Ministerial Fire in the Kidneys by draining Damp-Heat from the lower Jiao.
With Mu Tong, for Lin Syndrome with scanty urine and edema.
With Chi Fu Ling, facilitates the removal of water and leaches out Dampness to treat stagnant water and Dampness leading to edema, jaundice, diarrhea, Milky Lin, and scanty, difficult urination with abdominal distention.
Polyporus
Zhu Ling
9g
Dispels Damp-Heat .
With Chi Fu Ling, for Lin syndrome, scanty urine, edema, loose stools, vaginal discharge, jaundice, leg Qi and diarrhea.
With Ze Xie, drains Damp, unblocks and drains urinary pathways and drains Heat from the Bladder.
Caulis Akebiae
Mu Tong
6g
Promotes urination and unblocks painful urinary dysfunction .
With Ze Xie, for Pelvic infections.
Olibanum
Ru Xiang
6g
Invigorates the Blood, promotes the movement of Qi and reduces swelling.
Rx. Platycodi
Jie Geng
4.5g
Opens the Lungs, spreads Lung Qi, expels Phlegm and benefits the throat .
FORMULA ACTIONS
Clears Lung Heat
Moves Qi
Disinhibits water
SYNDROMES
Lung Heat with Qi Stagnation
CLINICAL MANIFESTATIONS
Uneasy, inhibited urination
Drips and drops, but lack of free flow
Lower abdominal distention and pain
A dry throat with a desire to drink
Vexation and chest oppression
Uneasy respiration
Maybe cough
Maybe Phlegm panting
T: Red
C: Yellow
P: Slippery and rapid
TREATS
Benign prostatitic hypertrophy

Joint soreness or pain

HERB FORMULAS
PU JI XIAO DU YIN JIA
JIAN -
普濟消毒飲加減 - MODIFIED UNIVERSAL BENEFIT DECOCTION TO ELIMINATE TOXIN
English:
Modified Universal
Benefit Decoction to Eliminate Toxin
Also Known As:
Modified Scute and Cimicifuga Combination
sections.ACTIONS:
Wine-fried Rx. Scutellariae
Jiu Chao Huang Qin
6-15g
Clear Lung Heat, drains Fire, dries Dampness, detoxifies and stops bleeding.
With Jiu Chao Huang Lian , clears and drains toxic Heat from the Upper Jiao.
Wine-fried Rz. Coptidis
Jiu Chao Huang Lian
3-15g
Drains Fire, relieves toxicity, drains Dampness, clears Heart and Stomach Fire and stops bleeding. It reaches the head and eyes and cools Upper Jiao Fire to treat pain of the eyes, ears, or tongue and mouth ulcers due to pathogenic Fire or Heat.
With Sheng Ma , clear s and drains Heart and Spleen Fire with swelling of the gums, toothache and ulcerations of the mouth and tongue.
With Lian Qiao and Ban Lan Gen , for acute infectious diseases.
Fr. Forsythiae
Lian Qiao
3-12g
Clears Heat, relieves toxicity, dissipates nodules, expels external Wind-Heat.
With Ban Lan Gen for any externally contracted
Heat disorder.
Bombyx Batryticatus
Jiang Can
1-6g
Alleviates pain due to Wind-Heat, transforms Phlegm, dissipates nodules and stops itch.
Rx. Scrophulariae
Xuan Shen
6-10g
Clears Heat, cools the blood, nourishes Yin , drains Fire, relieves toxicity, softens hardness and dissipates nodules.
With Sheng Ma , Niu Bang Zi and Jie Geng for swollen, painful throat due to Wind-Heat.
With Ma Bo, clears the upper body, restores normal descent, nourishes Yin and stops pain and treats Wind-Heat obstruction leading to swelling and pain of the throat.
With Jie Geng, Ma Bo and Ban Lan Gen for throat pain, with strong fever and chills and redness, swelling and burning pain of the face.
With Jie Geng and Gan Cao, for sore throat with
Dryness and pain.
Fr. Lasiosphere
Ma Bo
3-9g
Clears Lung Heat, relieves Fire toxicity, improves the throat and stops bleeding.
With Xuan Shen, for Wind-Heat obstruction leading to swelling and pain of the throat.
Rx. Isatidis
Ban Lan Gen
3-12g
Drains Heat, relieves Fire toxicity, cools the Blood and benefits the throat.
With Ma Bo, Jie Geng and Xuan Shen, for throat pain as part of a massive febrile disorder of the head with a strong fever and chills, with redness, swelling and burning pain of the face.
Rx. Platycodi
Jie Geng
3-9g
Opens the Lungs, spreads Lung Qi expels Phlegm, expels pus, benefits the throat and directs the effects of other herbs to the upper body.
With Gan Cao and Jiu Chao Huang Qin, for hoarseness, pain and swelling of the throat due to Wind-Heat.
Rx. Glycyrrhizae
Gan Cao
1-6g
Stops cough, clears Heat, relieves Fire toxicity, moderates spasms, alleviates pain and moderates and harmonizes the properties of other herbs.
With Jie Geng, for pain and swelling of the throat.
Rz. Cimicifugae
Sheng Ma
1.5-6g
Releases the exterior, vents measles, clears Heat, relieves toxicity, raises Yang , lifts Sunken Qi and guides other herbs upwards.
Rx. et Rz. Rhei
Da Huang
3-12g
Drains Heat and p urges
accumulations Drains Fire Clears
Heat, transforms Dampness and promotes urination
With Huang Lian, for a feeling of fullness and distention
due to Heat accumulation.
FORMULA ACTIONS
Clears Heat
Eliminates Fire toxin
Clears Yang Ming Fu
Regulates the throat
SYNDROMES
Acute fever of the head due to Yang Ming Fu
CLINICAL MANIFESTATIONS
Persistent fever
Very sore throat
Thirst
Difficulty swallowing
Red, swollen tonsils with a whitish area of exudate

QIAO HE TANG - 翘荷汤 - FORSYTHIA AND MINT DECOCTION
English:
Forsythia and Mint Decoction
Also Known As:
sections.ACTIONS:
Hb. Mentha Haplocalycis
Bo He
5g
Disperses Wind-Heat, cools
and clears the head and eyes and benefits the throat
Fr. Forsythiae
Lian Qiao
10g
Clears Heat, especially in the Upper Jiao and relieves toxicity .
Rx. Glycyrrhizae
Gan Cao
3g
Moistens the Lungs, r esolves Phlegm, s tops coughing , clears Heat, r elieves Fire toxicity, moderates and harmonizes the harsh properties of other herbs and guides the herbs to all twelve channels .
With Jie Geng, for pain and swelling of the throat.
Sm. Sesame Nigri
Hei Zhi Ma
12g
Nourishes and fortifies Liver and Kidney Yin and moistens and lubricates
the Intestines and Lungs .

Jie Geng
6g
Opens the Lungs, spreads Lung Qi, expels Phlegm, benefits the throat and opens and raises Lung Qi , directing the effects of other herbs to the upper body .

5g

HERB FORMULAS
QING HAI FENG TENG TANG - 青海风藤汤 - SINOMENIUM AND PIPERIS KADSURA DECOCTION
English:
Sinomenium and Piperis Kadsura Decoction
Also Known As:
sections.ACTIONS:
Caulis Spatholobi
Ji Xue Teng
15g
Invigorates and tonifies the Blood, activates the channels and r elaxes the sinews .
Rx. Achyranthis Bidentatae
Niu Xi
9g
Invigorates the Blood, e xpels Blood Stasis, strengthens the sinews and bones and benefits the joints .
With Du Zhong, for low back and extremity pain and weakness due to Bi pain or Kidney Deficiency.
Cx. Eucommiae
Du Zhong
9g
Tonifies Kidney Yang , s trengthens the sinews and bones and aids the smooth flow of Qi and Blood.
With Xu Duan, tonifies the Liver and Kidneys, strengthens the lower back
and secures the Chong and Ren channels to
treat aching in the lower back and knees.
Rx. Dipsaci
Xu Duan
9g
Tonifies the Liver and Kidneys, strengthens the sinews and bones , promotes the movement of Blood and alleviates pain .
With Du Zhong and Niu Xi, for Deficient Kidneys or Cold-Damp Bi causing low back and leg pain and weakness and contracture of the leg muscles.
Fr. Ailanthi
Feng Yen Cao
9g
Eliminates Wind, invigorates the Blood and expels Dampness .
Rz. Sinomenii
Qing Feng Teng
9g
Dispels Wind-Damp Bi , unblocks the channels and collaterals and relieves pain .
Rz. Piperis Kadsurae
Hai Feng Teng
9g
Dispels Wind-Dampness, unblocks the channels, disperses Cold and s tops pain.
With Gui Zhi, for pain, impaired joint movement and spasms of the sinews due to Wind-Damp Bi .
Rx. Angelicae Sinensis
Dang Gui
9g
Tonifies, invigorates and harmonizes the Blood,
disperses Cold and stops pain due to Blood Stasis.
With Huang Qi, for Qi and Blood Deficiency.
With Bai Shao, regulates and harmonizes Qi and Blood.
Rx. Rehmanniae Preparata
Shu Di Huang
9g
Nourishes the Blood .
With Dang Gui, for Blood Deficiency marked by dizziness, palpitations, insomnia and menstrual dysfunction.
Rx. Astragali
Huang Qi
9g
Tonifies Qi and Blood, tonifies Wei Qi , stabilizes the Exterior and relieves numbness and pain.
With Dang Gui, for Qi and Blood Deficiency with painful obstruction and paresthesia.
with Gui Zhi, for Qi and Blood Deficiency and Ying and Wei Deficiency with numbness and painful obstruction of the musculature.
Rx. Paeoniae Alba
Bai Shao
9g
Nourishes the Blood and harmonizes the Ying and Wei .
With Shu Di Huang and Dang Gui, for dizziness, blurred vision and dysmenorrhea due to Blood Deficiency or Stasis.
With Gui Zhi, harmonizes the Ying and Wei .
With Dang Gui, nourishes Yin and Blood.
Ram. Cinnamomi
Gui Zhi
9g
Releases the Exterior, assists Yang, a djusts the Ying and Wei, warms the channels and collaterals to relieve pain, unblocks Yang,
transforms Qi and thin mucus and warms and facilitates the flow of Qi through the channels and collaterals and Blood through the vessels.
FORMULA ACTIONS

Tonifies Qi
Strengthens Yang

Strengthens the tendons

HERB FORMULAS
QING HAO BIE JIA TANG - 青蒿鳖甲汤 - SWEET WORMWOOD AND SOFT-SHELL TURTLE DECOCTION
English:
Sweet Wormwood and Soft-Shelled Turtle Shell Decoction
Also Known As:
Artemisia Annua and Soft-Shelled Turtle Shell Decoction
Decoction of Sweet Wormwood and Tortoise Shell
Decoction of Artemisia Annua and Carapax Trionycis
sections.ACTIONS:
Carapax Trionycis
Bie Jia
15-30g
Nourishes the Yin and anchors the Yang .
With Sheng Di Huang, Mu Dan Pi, Qing Hao and Zhi Mu, for injured Yin in the aftermath of a febrile disease with fever and night sweats followed by a sense of cooling in the morning.
Hb. Artemisiae Annuae
Qing Hao
6-10g
Clears Deficiency fevers.
With Bie Jia, for the final stages of a warm febrile disease when the Yin Fluids have already been damaged and the pathogen still lurks deep within the Yin level with night fever with chills in the morning, the fever recedes without sweating, emaciation, rapid pulse and a red tongue with little coating.
With Bie Jia and Sheng Di Huang, for fever due to Heat in the Yin regions of the body.
With Bie Jia, Sheng Di Huang and Mu Dan Pi, for Heat in the Ying Level with constant feverish sensations.
Rx. Rehmanniae
Sheng Di Huang
12-20g
Clears Heat, cools the Blood , nourishes Yin , generates fluids and increases saliva.
With Mu Dan Pi, for residual warm pathogen which has injured the Yin
and Kidney Yin Deficiency with steaming bones.
Rz. Anemarrhenae
Zhi Mu
6-10g
Clears Heat transforms Phlegm, dissipates nodules and stops cough.
Cx. Moutan
Mu Dan Pi
9-10g
Clears Heat, cools (and harmonizes) the Blood and c lears Deficiency Fire.
With Qing Hao and Bie Jia, for steaming bone disorder.
With Sheng Di Huang and Zhi Mu, for Menopause with Yin Deficiency and Heat.
FORMULA ACTIONS
Nourishes the Yin
Vents Interior Deficiency Heat
SYNDROMES
Heat lurking in the Yin aspects of the body (usually due to later stages of a Warm-Heat pathogen)
CLINICAL MANIFESTATIONS
Night fever with morning coolness
No sweating
Emaciation
No loss of appetite
Tidal fever in the afternoon
T: Red
C:Little
P: Thready and rapid
TREATS
Low-grade fevers during the recovery stage of infectious diseases
Fever of unknown origin
Fever from cancer
Fever after surgery
Fever in children
Convalescent period of typhoid fever
Lupus erythematosus
Hot flashes
AIDS/HIV
Pulmonary tuberculosis
Renal tuberculosis
Common cold
Vertigo
Phthisis
Chronic pyelonephritis
Menopausal symptoms
Chronic pyelonephritis
Osteoarthritis
sections.CONTRAINDICATIONS:
Contraindicated during the early stages of Warm Heat febrile diseases.
Contraindicated for those with spasms and convulsions ( Yin deficiency with Liver Wind Rising).

English:
Clear Metal and Transform Phlegm Pill
Also Known As:
sections.ACTIONS:
Rx. Scutellariae
Huang Qin
12g
Clears Heat, dries Dampness , drains Fire, detoxifies, cools the Blood and stops bleeding.
With Zhi Zi, powerfully clears and drains lurking Heat from the Lungs.
With Sang Bai Pi, Gua Lou and Mai Men Dong, for acute and chronic cough due to Lung Heat.
With Sang Bai Pi and Zhi Mu, for Lung Heat cough.
Fr. Gardeniae
Zhi Zi
12g
Clears Heat, reduces Fire, resolves Dampness and eliminates irritability.
Rz. Anemarrhenae
Zhi Mu
15g
Clears Heat from the Lungs, drains Fire, nourishes Yin and moistens Dryness .
With Huang Qin, for cough with Excess Lung Heat.
Sm. Trichosanthis
Gua Lou Ren
15g
Clears Heat, transforms Hot Phlegm, cools and moistens the Lungs, expands the chest , moistens the Intestines and promotes bowel movements
Bul. Fritillariae Thunbergii
Zhe Bei Mu
9g
Clears Heat, transforms Phlegm and stops cough.
With Zhe Bei Mu, for cough due to Lung Heat or Yin Deficiency with expectoration of thick, yellow sputum.
Rx. Ophiopogonis
Mai Men Dong
9-15g

Per. Citri Reticulatae
Chen Pi

Opens the Lungs, spreads Lung Qi, expels Phlegm, benefits the throat and raises Lung Qi , directing the effects of other herbs to the upper body .

With Huang Qin, drains Heat from the Lungs, and stops cough and wheezing.
(Rx. Glycyrrhizae)
( Gan Cao )
(3-6g)

Clears Lung Fire

Transforms Phlegm

Asthma

Pneumonia
Red, sore eyes

QING LIAN GAO - 清脸膏 - CLEAR THE FACE OINTMENT
English:
Clear the Face Ointment
Also Known As:
sections.ACTIONS:
Rx. Angelicae Sinensis
Dang Gui
15g
Tonifies Blood, invigorates and harmonizes Blood, reduces swelling, expels pus, generates flesh and alleviates pain.
Rx. Lithospermi
Zi Cao
10g
Clears Heat. cools the Blood, relieves Fire toxins, encourages rashes and clears Damp-Heat from the skin.
Sesame Oil
1 liter
Yellow Wax
50g
FORMULA ACTIONS
Nourishes, Moistens and Invigorates the Blood
Clears Heat
SYNDROMES
Blood Heat sores (topical)
Blood Deficiency sores (topical)
Blood Stasis sores (topical)
Blood Dryness sores (topical)
CLINICAL MANIFESTATIONS
Small coin sized red or pale red or moist pale red or dark or hyper pigmented lesions located on the scalp, body, extremities, and other areas that increase rapidly
There are covered scales which are tightly covered or heaped up and are easily shed when scratched or thick hard and adherent
Removing the scale reveals a light pink shining membrane
Beneath the membrane are petechiae
Longstanding lesions may overlap
Lesions may be painful or fissured
Itching may be intense
TREATS
Psoriasis (topical)
sections.NOTES:
Put herbs into a pot with 5000 ml vegetable oil for 2 hours.
Bake until yellow.
Apply topically 1-2 times per day.

HERB FORMULAS
QING WEN BAI DU YIN -
清瘟敗毒飲 - CLEAR EPIDEMICS AND OVERCOME
TOXIN DECOCTION
English:
Clear Epidemics and Overcome Toxin Decoction
Also Known As:
Decoction for Clearing Away Pestilent Factors and Detoxification
Antipyretic and Antitoxic Decoction, Antiphlogistic Decoction for Epidemic Diseases
sections.ACTIONS:
Gypsum Fibrosum
Shi Gao
20-240g
Clears Heat in the Qi Stage and drains Fire.
With Zhi Mu , for high fever from Wind-Heat or Qi Stage Heat or Yang Ming Heat with irritability and extreme thirst.
With Sheng Di Huang , for excessive Fire with injured fluids.
With Xuan Shen and Shui Niu Jiao , for Heat at the Qi and Blood Stages with skin eruptions and echymosis.
With Shui Niu Jiao, for epidemic Damp-Heat toxin with high fever, loss of consciousness, epistaxis, and rash.
With Sheng Di Huang and Zhi Mu, for Stomach Fire.
With Sheng Di Huang, Mu Dan Pi and Xuan Shen, for excessive Heat in the Qi and Xue Levels with continuous high fever and maculae.
With Huang Lian, Zhi Zi, Mu Dan Pi, Chi Shao and Zhi Mu, for influenza, epidemic poliomyelitis and epidemic encephalitis B with high fever, headache irritability dry mouth insomnia and in severe cases, bleeding
Rx. Anemarrhenae
Zhi Mu
3-18g
Clears Heat from the Qi Stage.
With Xuan Shen and Sheng Di Huang , for ulcers of the oral cavity.
With Huang Lian, for Blazing Stomach Fire with intense hunger, dry stools, dry, yellow tongue coat and a slippery rapid pulse.
With Gan Cao, regulates Cold and Heat, harmonizes the Exterior and Interior and treats malarial diseases with Tai Yin turbid Dampness fuming upward (irritability, Heat, profuse sweating).
With Huang Qin, for cough with Excess Lung Heat.
Rx. Glycyrrhizae
Gan Cao
1.5-12g
Clears Heat, relieves Fire toxicity and moderates and harmonizes the properties of other herbs.
With Jie Geng, for pain and swelling of the throat.
Hb. Lophatheri
Dan Zhu Ye
1.5-12g
Clears Heat and Eliminates irritability.
With Shi Gao, for lingering fever from febrile disease with insomnia, irritability and a scanty dry tongue coat, cough with fever in children and Heart and Stomach Heat with mouth ulcers and swollen gums
With Shi Gao and Zhi Mu , for febrile disease with irritability and thirst.
Cornu Bubali
Shui Niu Jiao
30-120g
Relieves Fire toxicity and cools the Blood.
With Sheng Di Huang , for loss of consciousness and delirium, with epistaxis, hematemesis, or purpura due to Blood Heat.
With Huang Lian and Xuan Shen , for high fever, loss of consciousness, delirium, hematemesis, epistaxis, and purpura associated with warm febrile disease.
With Shi Gao and Xuan Shen , for high fever which worsens at night, dark-red skin blotches, thirst, and a rapid pulse due to Fire in the Qi and Blood levels.
Rx. Rehmanniae
Sheng Di Huang
6-30g
Clears Heat and cools the Blood.
With Shui Niu Jiao, Mu Dan Pi and Chi Shao , for Toxic Heat in the Blood.
With Shui Niu Jiao and Mu Dan Pi , for rashes due to Blood Heat.
With Shui Niu Jiao and Xuan Shen, for Heat in the Ying Stage.
With Mu Dan Pi, for Ying and Xue Stage Heat with a high fever, scarlet tongue, thirst, a rash all over the body, epistaxis and hemoptysis, residual Warm pathogen which has injured the Yin
and Kidney Yin Deficiency with steaming bones.
With Xuan Shen, for Excess or Deficiency Heat patterns, late-stage febrile disease with irritability, thirst and constipation and Kidney Yin Deficiency with Fire Blazing with soreness and swelling in the throat, dry mouth and a parched tongue.
With Mu Dan Pi and Chi Shao, for purpura or bleeding with maculae and blotches on the skin.
Cx. Moutan
Mu Dan Pi
3-18g
Clears Heat, cools the Blood, drains pus and reduces swelling.
With Chi Shao , cools the Blood and disperses Stasis, for Ying Stage Heat with epistaxis, hemoptysis, hemafecia, hematuria, menorrhagia, purpuric rash, hematemesis, and Heat injuring the Ying and Xue levels, Blood Stasis disorders (amenorrhea, menstrual pain, traumatic injury) and irregular menstruation due to Heat and obstruction from Blood Deficiency.
With Chi Shao and Sheng Di Huang, for hematemesis and epistaxis due to Heat in the Xue level.
With Zhi Mu and Sheng Di Huang, for menopause with Yin Deficiency and Heat.
Rx. Paeoniae Rubra
Chi Shao
3-18g
Clears Heat and cools the Blood.
Rx. Scrophulariae
Xuan Shen
3-18g
Clears Heat, cools the Blood, drains Fire and relieves toxicity.
With Mu Dan Pi , for erysipelas and purplish rashes.
With Shi Gao, Shui Niu Jiao and Zhi Mu , for Excess Toxic Heat with maculae and eruptions.
With Sheng Di Huang, Shui Niu Jiao and Lian Qiao, for Ying Stage Heat.
With Shi Gao, Shui Niu Jiao and Zhi Mu, for Excess Toxic Heat with maculae and eruptions.
Rz. Coptidis
Huang Lian
3-18g
Drains Fire and Relieves toxicity.
With Huang Qin and Zhi Zi, for high fever, irritability, dry mouth and throat, and dark urine due to Fire Toxin in the three burners.
With Sheng Di Huang , for Insomnia and delirium due to unremitting Heat injuring the Ying level.
With Zhi Zi and Shi Gao , for Ying Stage Heat with delirium and loss of consciousness.
With Huang Qin, drains pathogenic Heat from the Upper and Middle Jiaos for high fever, redness, swelling and pain of the head and face, dry mouth, parched throat, ulcerations of the mouth and tongue, epistaxis, rashes and irritability in warm-febrile disease, explosive diarrhea and dysentery with burning pain in the anus or fitted, filthy stools and abdominal pain and nausea in pregnancy with Heat disturbing the fetus.
Rx. Scutellariae
Huang Qin
1.5-12g
Drains Fire and Detoxifies.
with Zhi Zi, powerfully clears and drains lurking Heat from the Lungs with fever, fullness in the chest, cough with yellow sputum and epistaxis or hematemesis, treats Damp-Heat and jaundice, sores due to Heat toxin
and irregular vaginal bleeding due to Liver Fire.
With Shi Gao, Zhi Mu and Mu Dan Pi, for Excess Heat with persistent high fever and irritability.
Fr. Gardeniae
Zhi Zi
3-18g
Clears Heat, reduces Fire, eliminates irritability, cools the Blood and relieves toxicity.
With Lian Qiao, for Heat entering the Pericardium, and Heat remaining in the Heart channel with sores in the mouth or on the tongue, dark, scanty urine or urinary discomfort
With Huang Lian, Huang Qin and Lian Qiao , for boils and carbuncles.
With Mu Dan Pi, resolves Qi Level constraint leading to Heat and Heat in the Blood, treats irregular menstruation, headache, red eyes, and thirst due to Liver Qi Heat from constraint and dysmenorrhea, headache, dry, scratchy eyes and intercostal pain due to Liver Blood Deficiency.
Fr. Forsythiae
Lian Qiao
3-18g
Clears Heat, relieves toxicity, clears Blood Heat and directs the formula to the upper body.
With Shi Gao, Sheng Di Huang and Xuan Shen, for Heart Fire.
Rx. Platycodi
Jie Geng
1.5-12g
Expels pus, benefits the throat and directs the effects of other herbs to the upper body.
With Gan Cao, disseminates Lung Qi, expels Phlegm, resolves toxicity, and expels pus for productive cough with hoarseness, pain and swelling of the throat due to Wind-Heat, Lung abscess with expectoration of pus and pain in the chest and flanks and Excess disorders in the Upper Jiao with no disorder in the Lower Jiao.
With Huang Qin and Gan Cao, for hoarseness, pain and swelling of the throat due to Wind-Heat (stronger action).
FORMULA ACTIONS
Clears Heat
Relieves toxicity
Cools the Blood
Drains Fire
Stops bleeding
SYNDROMES
Severe Fire in the Qi and Blood (Xue) stages
CLINICAL MANIFESTATIONS

Severe, stabbing headache

CLINICAL MANIFESTATIONS
Latent Stage :
Begins about 1 year after infection.
Relapses may occur.
After the second year new lesions are rare.
This stage may last several years or for the remainder of the patient's life.
In untreated cases, about one-third of those infected develop Late-Stage or Tertiary syphilis which may show up after many years.
Tertiary or Late-Stage :
Lesions develop between 3 and 10 years after infection.
The typical lesion is a rubbery,
chronic, localized inflammation characterized by centralized gray-white necrosis, surrounded by granulized tissue.
They increase slowly in size, heal gradually and leave scars.
They may affect an organ or tissue.
Often they occur in Submucosal tissue such as the :
Palate
Nasal septum
Pharynx
Larynx
They lead to tissue degeneration with perforation of the palate, or septum.
They occur in areas with good blood supply such as the :
Leg below the knee
Upper trunk
Face
Scalp
Eyes
Stomach
Lungs
Liver
Testicles
TREATS
Tertiary syphilis
Latent syphilis
sections.NOTES: Grind the ingredients into a fine powder. Mix with water to form a paste. Make into small pills the size of mung beans. Administer 5-10 pills twice daily with water.

There are toxic ingredients in this formula, do not use long-term.
Apply to a small area first to check for side effects.
Discontinue when inflammation is resolved.

Grind the first three ingredients into a fine powder, then add the
other two and continue grinding until a paste is formed. A few drops

tight jar. After washing the area with soap, apply with a sterile cotton
ball and rub gently. Apply once daily.

QU FENG TANG -
驱风汤 - DISPEL WIND DECOCTION
English:
Dispel Wind Decoction
Also Known As:
sections.ACTIONS:
Rx. Aconiti Preparata
Zhi Chuan Wu
6g
Expels Wind-Dampness, disperses Cold, Warms and activates channels and stops pain.
With Zhi Cao Wu , eliminates Wind, Cold and Dampness and alleviates pain.
Rx. Aconiti Kusnezoffii Preparata
Zhi Cao Wu
6g
Strongly expels Wind-Dampness, disperses Cold, Warms and activates channels and stops pain.
Ram. Cinnamomi
Gui Zhi
Releases external Wind-Cold from the muscle layer., harmonizes the Ying and Wei , warms the channels and collaterals, relieves pain, disperse, Cold, unblocks Yang and transforms Qi , warms and facilitates the flow of Yang Qi in the chest and warms and facilitates the flow of Blood through the vessels.
With Ma Huang , for Wind-Cold-Damp Bi .
With Bai Shao , for external Wind-Cold with disharmony between the Ying and Wei .
With Zhi Chuan Wu, for chills and painful extremities due to Yang Deficiency with Wind-Cold-Damp and backache due to Wind-Cold Damp Bi.
Rx. Angelica Dahuricae
Bai Zhi
10g
Expels Wind, alleviates pain and headache, and expels Dampness.
Rx. Saposhnikoviae
Fang Feng
12g
Releases the Exterior, expels Wind-Cold-Dampness, stops pain, expels Internal Wind, stops spasms, moves Qi , tonifies Spleen and treats gout.
Zaocys
Wu Shao She
12g
Dispels Wind-Dampness, strongly unblocks the channels, dispels Wind from the skin and sinews and strengthens tendons and bones.
Rz. Typhonii Preparatum
Zhi Bai Fu Zi
3g
Dries Dampness, expels Wind, stops spasms, expels Wind-Cold-Dampness, and alleviates pain.
Hb. Schizonepetae
Jing Jie
10g
Releases the exterior, expels Wind, moves Qi , regulates Blood and reduces swelling.
With Fang Feng, for exterior excess.
Rx. Angelica Sinensis
Dang Gui
10g
Nourishes, invigorates and harmonizes the Blood, disperses Cold and stops pain.
With Bai Shao , regulates and harmonizes Qi and Blood.
Rx. Paeoniae Alba
Bai Shao
10g
Nourishes Blood, astringes Yin , soothes the Liver, relieves pain and adjusts the Ying and Wei .
With Gui Zhi , harmonizes Ying and Wei .
With Dang Gui , nourishes Yin and Blood.
Hb. Ephedrae
Ma Huang
6g
Releases the Exterior and disperses Cold.
With Gui Zhi , for Wind-Cold-Damp Bi .
With Zhi Chuan Wu. for Wind-Cold Bi .

Dispels Wind
Warms the channels
Sedates pain
Circulates Qi
Harmonizes the Blood

Wind-Cold Damp Bi with Wind Predominant
Wind Bi

Moving pain

Aversion to Wind

C: Thin and white
P: Wiry and tight

Muscular rheumatism
Fibrositis
Rheumatic myalgia
Rheumatoid arthritis

THE LUNG PILL
English:
Moisten the Lung Pill
Also Known As:
sections.ACTIONS:
Fr. Chebulae
He Zi
3-10g
Astringes and descends Lung Qi , stops cough and improves the condition of the throat .
With Gan Cao, for a hoarse voice.
Galla Chinensis
Wu Bei Zi
1.5-7g
Astringes Lung Qi , stops cough and cools Deficiency Fire.
With Wu Wei Zi, for cough at dusk due to Yin Deficiency Fire Blazing upward and irritating the Lungs.
Fr. Schisandrae
Wu Wei Zi
1.5-9g
Astringes Lung Qi , stops cough, astringes sweat, g enerates fluids, tonifies the Kidneys and astringes Jing .

Huang Qin
3-18g
Clears Heat, dries Dampness , drains Fire, detoxifies, cools the Blood and stops bleeding.
Rx. Glycyrrhizae
Gan Cao

Moistens the Lungs, r esolves Phlegm, s tops cough, clears Heat, r elieves Fire toxicity and m oderates and harmonizes the harsh properties of other herbs.
Mel
Feng Mi
15-30g
Nourishes the Lung and s tops cough.
FORMULA ACTIONS
Moistens and nourishes the Lung Yin
Restrains Fire
Supports the voice
SYNDROMES
Lung and Kidney Yin Deficiencies
CLINICAL MANIFESTATIONS
A hoarse voice which is sometimes more mild then severe
The voice is low and talking can be accomplished with great effort only
It is difficult to speak for a long time
The condition is aggravated with fatigue or excessive speaking
After rest, the hoarse voice may improve
Mild soreness of the laryngeal area which is dry and uncomfortable
Often the habit of clearing one's throat is noted
The larynx and the vocal cords are mildly red, slightly swollen and the borders are dull
Dry cough with scanty sputum
Often there is a sticky exudate
Opening and closing of the glottis is impeded or incomplete
Weak and soft lower back and knees
Restlessness
Insomnia
Thirst
Dry throat
Dry itch
Malar flush in the afternoon
T: Red
C: Scanty
P: Thready and rapid
TREATS
Chronic laryngitis

HERB FORMULAS
SAN BIAN DI HUANG TANG - 散边地黄汤 - SCATTER THE INCLINED REHMANNIA DECOCTION
English:
Scatter the Inclined Rehmannia Decoction
Also Known As:
sections.ACTIONS:
Rx. Rehmanniae Preparata
Shu Di Huang
15-30g
Nourishes Jing and Blood, fills the Marrow and nourishes Liver and Kidney Yin .
With Shan Zhu Yu, nourishes Kidney Yin and secures Jing, while restraining urination and sweating.
With Shan Yao and Shan Zhu Yu, for dizziness, a weak and sore low back, night sweats, impotence and spermatorrhea due to Kidney and Liver Yin Deficiency.
Rx. Paeoniae Alba
Bai Shao
15-30g
Nourishes the Blood, calms Liver Yang and Liver Wind and a lleviates pain .
Fr. Corni
Shan Zhu Yu
10-30g
Stabilizes the Kidneys, astringes Jing and Body Fluids, tonifies Liver and Kidney Yin and strengthens Kidney Yang .
With Shu Di Huang, Shan Yao and Gou Qi Zi, for True Yin Deficiency.
Rz. Chuanxiong
Chuan Xiong
10-15g
Invigorates the Blood, promotes the movement of Qi and a lleviates pain .
Rz. Dioscoreae
Shan Yao
10-15g
Tonifies Kidney Yin and astringes Jing .
With Shan Zhu Yu and Shu Di Huang, for Kidney Deficiency with spermatorrhea and night sweats.
Rx. Angelicae Dahuricae
Bai Zhi
6-12g
Expels Wind , eliminates Dampness, dispels Cold and alleviates pain.
With Chuan Xiong, for headaches.
Rz. Cyperi
Xiang Fu
6-12g
Spreads and regulates Liver Qi .
With Chuan Xiong, for Qi Stagnation combined with Blood Stasis.
Sm. Sinapis
Bai Jie Zi
6-12g
Promotes Qi movement, dissipates nodules, unblocks the collaterals, expels Phlegm a nd alleviates pain.
Cx. Moutan
Mu Dan Pi
6-12g
Clears Heat, cools and harmonizes the Blood , clears Deficiency Fire, invigorates the Blood and dispels Blood Stasis .
Rx. Glycyrrhizae
Gan Cao
3-10g
Moderates spasms, a lleviates pain , moderates and harmonizes the harsh properties of other herbs and guides the herbs to all twelve channels .
With Bai Shao, moderates spasms and alleviates pain, for painful spasms of the leg or abdomen.
FORMULA ACTIONS
Invigorates the Blood
Transforms Stasis
Dredges the Liver
Tonifies the Spleen
Nourishes the Kidneys
Tonifies Jing
Fills the Marrow

Complex post-concussion syndrome

Headache
Dizziness
Irritability
Palpitations
Fear
Agitation
Unsteadiness
Anxiety
Depression
Tinnitus
Deafness
Memory loss
Lack of concentration
Irritability
Worry
TREATS
Post-concussion syndrome

HERB FORMULAS
SAN BI TANG - 三痺湯 - THREE PAINFUL OBSTRUCTION DECOCTION
English:
Three Painful Obstruction Decoction
Also Known As:
Du Huo and Gentian Macrophy Combination
sections.ACTIONS:
Rx. Dipsaci
Xu Duan
30g
Tonifies the Liver and Kidneys, strengthens sinews and bones, promotes the movement of Blood, alleviates pain, generates flesh and reconnects sinews and bones.
With Du Zhong, tonifies the Liver and Kidneys, strengthens the lower back and secures the Chong and Ren channels to treat aching in the lower back and knees and weakness of the legs which makes walking difficult
Cx. Eucommiae
Du Zhong
30g
Tonifies the Kidneys and Liver, s trengthens the sinews and bones and aids the smooth flow of Qi and Blood .
Rx. Saposhnikoviae
Fang Feng
30g
Releases the exterior, e xpels External Wind , expels Wind-Dampness, a lleviates pain, expels Internal Wind and s tops spasms.
With Huang Qi, prevents Wind from entering the skin.
With Qin Jiao, for Wind Damp Bi with spasms of the tendons or numbness of the limbs and pain due to Wind-Dampness in patients with Blood Deficiency.
Cx. Cinnamomi
Rou Gui
30g
Warms the Kidneys, Spleen and Heart, strengthens the Yang and Ming Men Fire, disperses deep Cold, w arms the channels,
u nblocks the channels and vessels, a lleviates pain and assists the generation of Qi and Blood.
Hb. cum Rx. Asari
Xi Xin
30g
Disperses Wind-Cold and Internal Cold and alleviates pain.
With Chuan Xiong, for Wind-Cold headache, toothache and Bi pain.
With Du Huo, for joint pain due to Wind-Cold-Dampness.
With Chuan Xiong and Fang Feng, for Bi syndrome.
Rx. Ginseng
Ren Shen
30g
Tonifies Qi in Deficiency patients with Exterior conditions .
With Huang Qi, for Qi Deficiency with general debility, anorexia, and spontaneous sweat.
Poria
Fu Ling
30g
Promotes urination, leaches out Dampness, strengthens the Spleen and harmonizes the Middle Jiao.
Rx. Angelicae Sinensis
Dang Gui
30g
Tonifies, invigorates and harmonizes the Blood, disperses Cold and stops pain due to Blood Stasis.
With Huang Qi, for Qi and Blood Deficiencies.
With Bai Shao, regulates and harmonizes Qi and Blood.
With Gan Cao, moderates spasms and relieves abdominal pain.
With Chuan Xiong, harmonizes, nourishes and invigorates the Blood and disperses Blood Stasis.
Rx. Paeoniae Alba
Bai Shao
30g
Nourishes the Blood, calms Liver Yang and Liver Wind, softens the Liver and a lleviates pain.
With Gan Cao, for muscle spasms, pain and numbness, especially in the calf, due to Blood Deficiency.
With Du Huo, Qin Jiao, Ren Shen, Dang Gui and Gan Cao, for chronic Bi Syndrome with injury to Qi and Blood leading to spasms of the extremities.
Rx. Glycyrrhizae
Gan Cao
30g
Tonifies the Spleen, augments Qi, moderates spasms, a lleviates pain and moderates and harmonizes the harsh properties of other herbs.
With Ren Shen, relieves palpitations and anxiety.
Rx. Gentianae Macrophyllae
Qin Jiao
15g
Expels Wind-Dampness, opens the channels and soothes the sinews and collaterals.
With Dang Gui and Bai Shao, for Blood Deficiency with hemiplegia, especially with excess muscle tension in the upper extremities.
Rx. Rehmanniae
Sheng Di Huang
15g
Clears Heat and cools the Blood .
With Bai Shao, for Blood Deficiency Heat.
Rz. Chuanxiong
Chuan Xiong
15g
Invigorates the Blood, promotes the movement of Qi, expels Wind and a lleviates pain.
With Dang Gui, for Wind-Damp Invasion blocking the Blood vessels causing pain, numbness, and paralysis.
With Xi Xin and Fang Feng, for Wind-Cold Headaches.
Rx. Angelicae Pubescentis
Du Huo
15g
Dispels Wind-Dampness, alleviates pain , disperses Wind-Cold-Dampness and releases the exterior.
With Xi Xin and Qin Jiao, for Wind-Damp Bi causing numbness, pain and soreness in the neck, back and lower extremities.
Rx. Astragali
Huang Qi
30g
Tonifies Qi and Blood and relieves numbness and pain.
With Dang Gui, for Qi and Blood Deficiencies with chronic non-healing sores, numbness, painful obstruction and paresthesia.
Rx. Cyathulae
Chuan Niu Xi
30g
Invigorates the Blood, dispels Blood Stasis, expels Wind, drains Dampness, tonifies the Kidneys and Liver and strengthens the tendons and bones.
Rz. Zingiberis Recens
Sheng Jiang
6g
Releases the Exterior, induces perspiration,
d isperses Cold, w arms the Middle and reduces the toxicity of the other herbs.
With Da Zao, nourishes the Blood, prevents injury from harsh Blood movers and assists the movement of Qi.
Fr. Jujube
Da Zao
6g
Tonifies the Spleen and Stomach, augments Qi , nourishes the Blood, c alms the Spirit and m oderates and harmonizes the harsh properties of the other herbs.
With Sheng Jiang, enhances the effects of other Qi and Blood tonifying herbs by facilitating their digestion and absorption.
FORMULA ACTIONS
Tonifies the Liver and Kidneys
Augments Qi
Nourishes the Blood
Dispels Wind, Cold and Dampness
SYNDROMES
Liver and Kidney Deficiency with Qi and Blood Deficiency
Wind-Cold-Damp Bi with underlying Qi and Blood Deficiency
CLINICAL MANIFESTATIONS
The sinews and bones are soft and weak
The pain is worse with exposure to Cold and Damp weather
Numbness and pain of the muscles and joints
Joint pain
Tremors of the hands and feet
Decreased range of motion
T: Pale
C: Whitish
P: Thin, weak and slow
TREATS
Arthritis
Arthralgia
Rheumatism
Numbness
Stroke
General aches and pains in the muscles and bones
Fibromyalgia
Paresthesia
sections.NOTES: This formula nourishes Qi and Blood to Extinguish Wind.

For Bi Syndrome with more Cold:

Qiang Huo
+ Hb. Ephedrae
Ma Huang

Gui Zhi

Zhi Fu Zi

For fibromyalgia due to Damp Stagnation Blocking the Channels:
+ Rz. Atractylodis
Cang Zhu

Wei Ling Tang
+ Hb. Artemisiae Scopariae
Yin Chen Hao

or

Fu Zi Li Zhong Tang

Yan Nian Ban Xia Tang
+ Kudzu Decoction modified
Ge Gen Tang modified

or

+ Bolster the Spleen Decoction
Shi Pi Yin

Du Huo
