HERB FORMULAS
SAN BI WAN JIA JIAN - 三痺囊加減 - MODIFIED THREE KINDS OF RHEUMATISM PILL
English:
Modified Three Kinds of Rheumatism Pill
Also Known As:
sections.ACTIONS:
Rx. Angelica Pubescentis
Du Huo
10-11g
Releases the Exterior, dispels Wind-Cold-Dampness, opens the channels, vitalizes vessels and stops pain.
With Qin Jiao , expels Wind-Cold-Damp, relieves arthralgia and stops pain.
Rx. Gentianae Macrophyllae
Qin Jiao
10-11g
Clears Heat, expels Wind-Dampness, relaxes sinews, clears Deficiency Heat and resolves Dampness - good for cramps in the limbs.
Rx. Clematidis
Wei Ling Xian
10-11g
Dispels Wind-Dampness, opens the channels, alleviates pain, reduces Phlegm and dispels Dampness - good for swelling, arthralgia with numbness and spasms.
Rx. Stephaniae Tetrandrae
Han Fang Ji
8-10g
Expels Wind-Dampness, alleviates pain and promotes urination.
(Cx. Erythrinae)
( Hai Tong Pi )
(8-10g)
(Substitutes for Han Fang Ji )
Fr. Chaenomelis
Mu Gua
8-10g
Relaxes sinews (increases Qi and Blood circulation), opens the channels and transforms Dampness - good for lower back and extremities.
Caulis Trachelospermi
Luo Shi Teng
9-10g
Dispels Wind-Dampness and opens channels.
Cx. Eucommiae
Du Zhong
8-10g
Tonifies the Kidneys and Liver, strengthens the sinews and bones and circulates Qi and Blood.
Rx. Astragali
Huang Qi
9-10g
Strengthens the Spleen, tonifies Qi , consolidates Wei Qi , stabilizes the Exterior and nourishes Blood.
With Zhi Gan Cao , strengthens Qi and consolidates Wei .
With Gui Zhi, for Qi and Blood Deficiencies and Ying and Wei Deficiencies with numbness and painful obstruction of the musculature.
Rx. Cyathulae
Chuan Niu Xi
8-10g
Expels Wind, drains Dampness, opens the channels, invigorates the Blood and eliminates Blood Stasis.- especially good for knee pain and flaccid extremities.
Caulis Spatholobi
Ji Xue Teng
9-10g
Nourishes and invigorates the Blood, opens the channels and relaxes sinews - good for numbness, low back pain and knee pain.
Hb. Taxilli
Sang Ji Sheng
8-10g
Strengthens the sinews and bones, tonifies Liver and Kidney Yin , expels Wind-Dampness and nourishes the Blood. - good for low back and knees.
With Du Huo and Chuan Niu Xi , for Kidney and Liver Yin Deficiency and Wind-Dampness causing low back and leg pain, stiffness and soreness.
Rx. Angelica Sinensis
Dang Gui
8-10g
Nourishes, invigorates and harmonizes the Blood, disperses Cold and stops pain.
With Zhi Gan Cao, moderates spasms.
With Huang Qi, for Blood Deficiency.
Rx. Saposhnikoviae
Fang Feng
9-10g
Releases the Exterior, expels Wind-Cold-Dampness, stops pain, expels Internal Wind, stops spasms, moves Qi , tonifies the Spleen and treats gout.
With Qin Jiao, for Wind Dampness Bi with spasms of the tendons or numbness of the limbs and pain due to Wind-Dampness in patients with Blood Deficiency.
Ram. Cinnamomi
Gui Zhi
9-10g
Releases external Wind-Cold from the muscle layer., harmonizes the Ying and Wei , warms the channels and collaterals, relieves pain, disperse, Cold, unblocks Yang , transforms the Qi , warms and facilitates the flow of Yang Qi in the chest and warms and facilitates the flow of Blood through the vessels.
With Han Fang Ji, for Wind-Cold Damp Bi.
Rx. Glycyrrhizae Preparata
Zhi Gan Cao
3-6g
Tonifies Qi , harmonizes and protects Stomach.
FORMULA ACTIONS
Dispels Wind-Cold-Damp
Tonifies Qi
Strengthens tendons
Nourishes and Activates the Blood
Breaks up Blood Stasis
Stops pain
SYNDROMES
Wind-Cold-Damp Bi with Blood Stasis
San Bi
CLINICAL MANIFESTATIONS
Aversion to Wind, Cold and Dampness
Stiff and painful muscles and joints
Limited movement
Pain aggravated by Wind
Sensitive to climatic changes
Pain aggravated by Cold
Numbness of muscles
Pain aggravated by Dampness
Cold joints
Pain worse at night
Low back pain or soreness
Lumbago
Fatigue
Heaviness of the body
Heaviness of the muscles
Preference for warmth
Weak joints
Palpitations
Pale face
Joint deformity
Shortness of breath
Preference for dry weather
T: Pale or Purplish
C: Thin, white and greasy
P: Thready and weak or Thready and slippery
TREATS
Osteoarthritis of the lumbar spine
Rheumatic diseases
Osteophytosis of the lumbar spine
Acute and chronic rheumatic pain
Rheumatic lumbago
Rheumatoid arthritis
Lumbar muscle strain
Gouty arthritis
Arthralgia
Osteoarthritis
Sciatica
Periarthritis of the shoulder
Fibrositis
Tenosynovitis
Nonarticular rheumatism
Tendinitis
Bursitis
sections.CONTRAINDICATIONS:
Contraindicated for those with Damp-Heat.

For severe pain:
+ 5g Cx. Cinnamomi
Rou Gui
+ 5g Scorpio
Quan Xie
+ 6g Rx. Aconiti Lateralis Preparata
Zhi Fu Zi
+ 10g Zaocys
Wu Shao She
For fixed, stabbing pain or pain which is worse
at night:
+ 5g Flos Carthami
Hong Hua
+ 6g Olibanum
Ru Xiang

+ 6g Myrrh
Mo Yao
+ 6g Rx. Ginseng
Ren Shen

SAN CHONG JIAO NANG - 三虫胶囊 - THREE INSECTS GELATIN CAPSULES
English:
Three Insects Gelatin Capsules
Also Known As:
sections.ACTIONS:
Pheretima
Di Long
4-15g
Drains Heat, settles convulsions, extinguishes Wind, unblocks and promotes movement in the channels and collaterals and s tops spasms.
Eupolyphaga/Steleophaga
Tu Bie Chong
1-1.5g
Breaks up and drives out
Blood Stasis and invigorates Blood circulation.
Bombyx Batryticatus
Jiang Can
1-3g
Extinguishes Wind and s tops spasms and convulsions and stops pain.
FORMULA ACTIONS
Drains Heat
Extinguishes Wind
Unblocks and promotes movement in the channels and collaterals
Stops spasms
Breaks up and drives out
Blood Stasis
Invigorates Blood circulation
SYNDROMES
Internal Wind
CLINICAL MANIFESTATIONS
Sudden paroxysmal burning in the facial region
Sudden pain while talking
Often appears after exposure to Wind
Sometimes the patient wakes from sleep
The pain is severe lasts from several seconds to two minutes
The pain suddenly stops
Pain mostly occurs in the maxillary and mandibular branches
Pain in the optic branch is rare
Most commonly seen in middle aged or older people
Seen more in women than men
Optic branch :
Forehead
Nose
Maxillary skin
Eyes
Maxillary branch :
Facial skin
Upper lip
Hard palate
Maxillary sinus
Mandibular branch :
Mandible
Oral cavity
Teeth
Tongue
External ear
TREATS
Trigeminal neuralgia
sections.NOTES: Powder the ingredients and put in 0.5g gelatin capsules. Take four capsules three times per day.

HERB FORMULAS
SANG BAI PI TANG - 桑白皮汤 - MULBERRY BARK DECOCTION
English:
Mulberry Bark Decoction
Also Known As:
sections.ACTIONS:
Cx. Mori
Sang Bai Pi
10g
Stops cough and wheezing and drains Heat from the Lungs.
With Huang Qin, drains Heat from the Lungs, and stops cough and wheezing.
With Ting Li Zi, for wheezing from water and thin mucus retained in the Lungs.
Rx. Scutellariae
Huang Qin
10g
Clears Lung Heat, dries Dampness, drains Fire and detoxifies.
With Huang Lian, drains pathogenic Heat from the Upper and Middle Jiaos for high fever, redness, swelling and pain of the head and face, dry mouth, parched throat, ulcerations of the mouth and tongue, epistaxis, rashes and irritability in warm-febrile disease.
With Huang Lian and Zhi Zi, for acute febrile disease.
With Zhi Zi, powerfully clears and drains lurking Heat from the Lungs with fever, fullness in the chest, cough with yellow sputum and epistaxis or hematemesis.
Rz. Coptidis
Huang Lian
2g
Clears Heat, drains Dampness, drains Fire and relieves toxicity.
With Huang Qin and Zhi Zi , for high fever, irritability, dry mouth and throat, and dark urine due to Fire toxin in the three burners
Dry-Fried Fr. Gardeniae
Chao Zhi Zi
10g
Clears Heat, reduces Fire, eliminates irritability, drains Damp-Heat, cools the Blood and relieves toxicity.
Fr. Perillae
Zi Su Zi
10g
Stops cough and wheezing, descends Qi , dissolves Phlegm and moistens the Intestines.
With Ting Li Zi, for accumulation of Phlegm and thin mucus leading to Lung Qi Stagnation and blockage with cough and wheezing which is worse when lying down, edema of the tissues of the face and head, stifling fullness and discomfort in the chest and reduction in the flow of urine.
With Xing Ren, for cough and wheezing with constipation.
Sm. Armeniacae
Xing Ren
6-9g
Regulates Lung Qi , stops cough and wheezing, moistens the Intestines and unblocks bowels.
With Chuan Bei Mu, for wheezing and cough from externally contracted Lung disorders, non-productive cough from Lung Deficiency disorders and coughing of thick, yellow sputum due to Phlegm-Fire.
Bul. Fritillariae Cirrhosae
Chuan Bei Mu
5g
Clears Heat, transforms Phlegm, stops cough and nourishes and moistens the Lungs.
With Huang Lian and Huang Qin, directs Phlegm-Fire downward.
Sm. Lepidii/Descurainiae
Ting Li Zi
10g
Drains the Lungs, reduces Phlegm and calms wheezing.
Rx. Stemonae
Bai Bu
10g
Stops cough and moistens the Lungs.
With Chuan Bei Mu , for cough and chest pain due to Phlegm Heat.
FORMULA ACTIONS
Stops cough and wheezing
Drains Heat from the Lungs
Dissolves Phlegm
Drains Dampness
Detoxifies
SYNDROMES
Retention of Phlegm Fire
CLINICAL MANIFESTATIONS
Paroxysmal gasping coughs with a strong barking sound
Thick, difficult to expectorate sputum
Noisy inhalation
Vomiting of mucus
Red eyes
Occasional Blood in the sputum
T: Red
C: Sticky
P: Rapid, slippery and forceful
TREATS
Pertussis
Gasping
Asthma
sections.MODIFICATIONS:
For frequent, violent spasmodic coughing:
For a dry cough with little sputum:
+ 6g Bombyx Batryticatus
Jiang Can
+ 12g Rx. Adenophorae
Nan Sha Shen

SANG ZHI SHI GAO ZHI MU TANG - 桑枝石膏知母汤 - MULBERRY TWIG, GYPSUM AND ANEMARRHEA DECOCTION
English:
Mulberry Twig, Gypsum and Anemarrhena Decoction
Also Known As:
sections.ACTIONS:
Ram. Mori
Sang Zhi
9-15g
Dispels Wind-Dampness, unblocks
the channels and collaterals, benefits the joints and s tops
spasms .
Rz. Anemarrhenae
Zhi Mu
6-12g
Clears Heat, drains Fire, nourishes Yin and moistens Dryness.
With Huang Bai, clears Heat and Drains Fire for Yin Deficiency Fire.
With Shi Gao, cools Heat in the Yang Ming or Qi Level while protecting Stomach fluids to treat high fever, profuse sweating, insatiable thirst, a red face, aversion to Heat and a large, strong pulse.
Rz. Atractylodis
Cang Zhu
3-10g
Strongly dries Dampness, tonifies the Spleen, induces sweating and expels Wind-Dampness .
With Shi Gao, for Warm-Damp febrile disease with fever, profuse sweating and generalized body aches.
With Huang Bai, for pain, swelling, and weakness of the lower extremities or skin lesions due to Wind-Dampness.
Cx. Phellodendri
Huang Bai
3-12g
Drains Damp-Heat especially from the Lower Jiao, drains Fire and relieves Fire toxicity.
With Zhi Mu, for Lower Jiao Damp-Heat.
Rx. Angelicae Sinensis
Dang Gui
3-15g
Tonifies, invigorates and harmonizes the Blood and alleviates pain.
Rz. et Rx. Notopterygii
Qiang Huo
3-10g
Expels Wind-Cold-Dampness, u nblocks painful obstruction and a lleviates pain .
With Du Huo, for Dampness.
With Cang Zhu, for a heavy-headed sensation.
Gypsum Fibrosum
Shi Gao
15-60g
Clears Heat in the Qi Stage, drains Fire, relieves irritability and quenches thirst
Rx. Angelicae Pubescentis
Du Huo
3-10g
Dispels Wind-Dampness and alleviates pain .
With Qiang Huo, for joint pain and numbness.
Rz. Clematidis
Wei Ling Xian
3-16g
Dispels Wind-Dampness, unblocks the channels and alleviates pain.
With Qiang Huo, for Wind-Damp Bi causing joint pain.
Rx. Stephaniae Tetrandrae
Han Fang Ji
3-12g
Expels Wind-Dampness, alleviates pain and purges Damp-Heat.
Sm. Coicis
Yi Yi Ren
9-30g
Expels Wind-Dampness, relieves pain, strengthens the Spleen , resolves Dampness and clears Damp-Heat.
Caulis Trachelospermi
Luo Shi Teng
6-16g
Dispels Wind-Dampness and unblocks the channels and collaterals .
Cx. Acanthopanacis
Wu Jia Pi
4.5-15g
Dispels Wind-Dampness, nourishes the Liver and Kidneys, strengthens the sinews and
bones, transforms Dampness and reduces swelling.
With Wei Ling Xian, Qiang Huo and Qin Jiao , for Wind-Damp Bi causing muscle spasms and pain.
Rx. Paeoniae Rubra
Chi Shao
4.5-15g
Invigorates the Blood, d ispels Blood Stasis, clears Heat and c ools the Blood and relieves pain .
Rx. Gentianae Macrophyllae
Qin Jiao
3-12g
Expels Wind-Dampness, opens the channels and soothes the sinews and collaterals .
Rx. Scutellariae
Huang Qin
3-18g
Clears Heat, dries Dampness, drains Fire and detoxifies .
With Qiang Huo, for Cold-Dampness at the Exterior with Heat in the Interior.
FORMULA ACTIONS
Dispels Wind-Dampness
Clears Heat
Unblocks the channels and collaterals
Relieves pain
SYNDROMES
Wind-Damp-Heat Bi
CLINICAL MANIFESTATIONS
Burning sensations
Generalized body aches and pains
Irritability
Heavy sensation in the shoulder and back
Discomfort or a constricted sensation in the area of the chest and diaphragm
Multiple sores, carbuncles furuncles or abscesses
Redness
Itching
Persistent swelling
Chest pain
Fever
Thirst
Aching and painful extremities
Aching and painful joints
Unbearable swelling and pain of the lower extremities
Shoulder stiffness
T: Normal
C: Greasy and slightly yellow
P: Wiry and rapid or Soft and moderate or Soft, superficial and slow or Slippery and rapid or Deep and tight
TREATS
Rheumatic arthritis
Arthritis
Arthralgia
Gout
Fibromyalgia
Painful obstruction

- 三黄石膏汤 -
THREE YELLOW AND GYPSUM DECOCTION
English:
Three Yellow and
Gypsum Decoction
Also Known As:
Gypsum, Coptis and Scute Combination
Decoction of Gypsum Fibrosum and Three Yellows
sections.ACTIONS:
Gypsum Fibrosum
Shi Gao
6-30g
Clears Heat in the Qi Stage,
drains Fire, relieves irritability, quenches thirst and clears
Excess Heat from the Lungs.
With Ma Huang, for cough from Heat Obstructing
the Lungs with wheezing, flaring of the nostrils and fever.
With Huang Qin, Huang Lian and Huang Bai, for
toxic Heat with infection.
Rx. Scutellariae
Huang Qin
3-10g
Clears Heat, Drains
Fire, detoxifies , cools the Blood and stops
bleeding.
With Huang Lian, drains pathogenic Heat from
the Upper and Middle Jiaos for high fever, redness, swelling
and pain of the head and face, dry mouth, parched throat, ulcerations
of the mouth and tongue, epistaxis, rashes and irritability in
warm-febrile disease.
With Huang Lian and Zhi Zi, for acute febrile
disease.
With Zhi Zi, powerfully clears and drains lurking Heat
from the Lungs with fever, fullness in the chest, cough with yellow
sputum and epistaxis or hematemesis.
Rz. Coptidis
Huang Lian
3-10g
Clears Heat, Drains
Fire, detoxifies , cools the Blood and stops bleeding.

Heat with delirium and loss of consciousness.

Huang Bai
3-10g

3-10g
Clears Heat, reduces Fire,
eliminates irritability, cools the Blood, relieves
toxicity and stops bleeding
by astringing.

Ma Huang
3-9g

3-10g

irritability, harmonizes the Middle Jiao and relieves
stuffy sensations in the chest .
Rz. Zingiberis Recens
Sheng Jiang
3-6g
Releases the Exterior, induces
perspiration d isperses Cold and reduces
the toxicity of other herbs .
With Ma Huang, strongly creates sweating to treat all
externally contracted Wind-Cold disorders, especially those in which
Wind-Cold has constrained Lung Qi with cough and wheezing
and the failure of Lung Qi to descend causing nausea and
vomiting.
With Da Zao,p rotects the Stomach Qi and reduces
irritation of the gastrointestinal tract by other herbs.

Da Zao
2-5g
Nourishes the Blood, c alms
the Spirit and moderates and
harmonizes the harsh properties of other herbs.
Fol. Camelliae Sinensis
Lu Cha
2-6g
Harmonizes the Stomach, descends
Rebellious Stomach Qi, quenches thirst and
removes toxins.

HERB FORMULAS
SAN REN TANG -
三仁湯 - THREE SEED (NUT) DECOCTION
English:
Three Seed (Nut) Decoction
Also Known As:
Apricot, Coix and Cluster Combination
sections.ACTIONS:
Sm. Armeniacae
Xing Ren
9-15g
Stops cough and wheezing, moistens the Intestines and unblocks the bowels.
With Hou Po, for Upper and Middle Jiao Dampness with a stifling sensation in the chest and epigastric and abdominal distention with a feeling of fullness.
Fr. Amomi Rotundus
Bai Dou Kou
3-6g
Aromatically transforms Dampness, warms the Middle Jiao , stops vomiting, descends Qi , moves Qi and transforms Stagnation.
With Xing Ren and Yi Yi Ren , for headache, stifling sensations in the chest, fatigue, dark, scanty urine, diarrhea, and usually with a white, greasy tongue coat as in the early stages of a warm febrile disease.
With Hou Po , for distention due to Qi Stagnation or Cold-Damp in the Spleen and Stomach.
Cx. Magnoliae Officinalis
Hou Po
3-6g
Transforms Dampness, promotes the movement of Qi , and descends Rebellious Qi .
Rz. Pinelliae Preparatum
Zhi Ban Xia
6-9g
Dries Dampness, transforms Phlegm, descends Rebellious Qi , harmonizes the Stomach and stops vomiting.
With Hou Po , for Phlegm-induced cough, vomiting, and epigastric and abdominal distention.
Sm. Coicis
Yi Yi Ren
10-18g
Promotes urination, leaches out Dampness, strengthens the Spleen, expels Wind-Dampness, clears Damp-Heat and stops diarrhea.
With Xing Ren and Bai Dou Kou , for early-stage Damp-Warmth with Damp predominant.
Medulla Tetrapanacis
Tong Cao
3-6g
Promotes urination and clears Heat.
With Hua Shi and Yi Yi Ren, for Summerheat with Turbid Dampness causing painful urinary dysfunction, a stuffy chest, heaviness in the body and headache.
With Bai Dou Kou, Hua Shi and Yi Yi Ren, for painful urination, cloudy urination and heaviness of the body due to Damp-Heat.
With Hua Shi, Yi Yi Ren, Zhi Ban Xia, Hou Po and Bai Dou Kou, for Damp febrile disorders with sensations of heaviness of the body, lack of thirst, chest oppression afternoon fever and dysuria.
Hb. Lophatheri
Dan Zhu Ye
3-6g
Clears Heat, eliminates irritability, promotes urination and Clears Damp-Heat.
Talcum
Hua Shi
10-18g
Promotes urination, drains Heat from the Bladder, expels Damp-Heat and releases Summerheat.
FORMULA ACTIONS
Spreads Qi
Facilitates Qi
Clears Damp-Heat (Clears Damp-Heat from the Qi Level by unblocking Lung
Qi , transforming and drying Dampness from the Middle Jiao , Draining Dampness from the Lower Jiao and Clearing Heat.)
SYNDROMES
Damp-Heat (early stage)
Summerheat with Damp
San Jiao Upper Jiao Heat
Wei Stage Damp-Heat
CLINICAL MANIFESTATIONS
Headache
Chills
Afternoon fever
Heavy sensation in the body
Generalized pain
Pale yellow (sallow) complexion
Stifling sensation in chest
Loss of appetite
Feverishness and pain of the body
Fatigue
Lack of thirst or thirst with no desire to drink
Chest and abdominal fullness
Maybe aversion to Cold
Nausea
Heaviness of the head
T: Normal
C: White or Greasy and white
P: Wiry, thin and soggy or soft or Superficial and soft

Fever of unknown origin
Biliary ascariasis
Enteric fever
Pyelonephritis

Gastroenteritis

Fatigue

Use only for Damp-Heat disorders where Damp is predominant.

HERB FORMULAS
SAN RE XIAO DU YIN - 三熱消毒饮 - DISSIPATE HEAT AND DISPERSE TOXINS DRINK
English:
Dissipate Heat and Disperse Toxins Drink
Also Known As:
sections.ACTIONS:
Fr. Arctii
Niu Bang Zi
12g
Disperses Wind-Heat Relieves toxicity.
With Lian Qiao, unblocks and drains Heat toxin, disperses clumps and swellings for sore, swollen throat, swellings like mumps, boils and other Heat toxin lesions and ulcerations and abscesses of the tongue and mouth.
Rz. et Rx. Notopterygii
Qiang Huo
10g
Releases the Exterior and d isperses Cold .
Rz. Coptidis
Huang Lian
6g
Drains Fire and resolves Fire toxicity .
With Huang Qin, drains pathogenic Heat from the Upper and Middle Jiaos for high fever, redness, swelling and pain of the head and face, dry mouth, parched throat, ulcerations of the mouth and tongue, epistaxis, rashes and irritability in warm-febrile disease.
Rx. Scutellariae
Huang Qin
10g
Drains Fire, detoxifies and calms ascending Liver Yang .
Hb. Menthae
Bo He
3g
Disperses Wind-Heat, cools
and clears the head and eyes and benefits the throat .
Fr. Forsythiae
Lian Qiao
12g
Clears Heat, especially in the Upper Jiao , and relieves toxicity .
With Niu Bang Zi and Bo He, for Wei Stage Heat.
FORMULA ACTIONS
Clears Heat
Dissipates Wind
Resolves toxicity
SYNDROMES
Lung and Spleen Heat
CLINICAL MANIFESTATIONS
Red eyes
Hot tears
Photophobia
Swollen eyelids which look like a red peach
Pain exacerbated by pressure
Pain sometimes radiates to the forehead
Maybe fever with aversion to Cold
T: Red
P: Rapid
TREATS
Red eyes
Photophobia
Swollen eyelids

Halloysitum Rubrum

3-30g

Summerheat
Damp-Heat

sections.ACTIONS:
Talcum
Hua Shi
9g

Gypsum Fibrosum

15g

Glauberitum
Han Shui Shi
9g

Sm. Armeniacae
Xing Ren

Caul. Bambusae in Taeniam

Three Substance Pill for Emergencies
Also Known As:
Rhubarb, Ginger and Croton Formula
Pills of Three Ingredients fo Sudden Syncope
sections.ACTIONS:
Sm. Crotonis
Ba Dou
30g
Warmly unblocks and vigorously purges accumulated Cold, drives out water and reduces edema.
Rz. Zingiberis
Gan Jiang
30g
Warms the Middle, e xpels Cold, rescues Devastated Yang and e xpels Interior Cold.
Rx. et Rz. Rhei
Da Huang
30g
Drains Heat and p urges accumulations .
FORMULA ACTIONS
Harshly Purges Cold Accumulation
Alleviates pain
SYNDROMES
Sudden onset of severe Cold Accumulation due to Cold Food Stagnation in the Stomach and Intestines

Sudden epigastric and abdominal pain and distention

Rough, uneven breathing
Stabbing pain in the chest

Rapid breathing
Constipation
Cold limbs

C: White or White and slippery
P: Deep and tight or Deep and slow

Intestinal obstruction
Acute cholecystitis
Sudden syncope

HERB FORMULAS
SCHIZOPHRENIA #3
English:
Also Known As:
sections.ACTIONS:
Per. Citri Reticulatae
Chen Pi
9g
Regulates Qi , adjusts the Middle, d ries Dampness and t ransforms Phlegm .
Rz. Pinelliae Preparatum
Zhi Ban Xia
9g
Dries Dampness, transforms Phlegm and descends Rebellious Qi.
With Chen Pi, for epigastric and abdominal distention or pain due to disharmony of the Stomach Qi .
With Fu Ling, treats Phlegm, thin mucus and turbid Dampness.
Fr. Aurantii Immaturus
Zhi Shi
6g
Breaks up Stagnant Qi , reduces accumulation, descends Qi and transforms Phlegm.
With Chen Pi, strengthens the Middle Jiao .
Arisaema cum Bile
Dan Nan Xing
6g
Clears Heat, dissolves Phlegm .
Poria
Fu Ling
9g
Promotes urination, leaches out Dampness , strengthens the Spleen, quiets the Heart, calms the Spirit and s oothes the nerves.
With Zhi Ban Xia and Chen Pi, for nausea, vomiting, chest fullness and distention and anorexia due to congested fluids.
With Gan Cao, for Spleen and Heart Deficiency causing facial edema, palpitations,
and shortness of breath.
Rz. Cyperi
Xiang Fu
9g
Spreads and regulates Liver Qi .
Rz. Acori Tatarinowii
Shi Chang Pu
9g
Opens the Orifices, vaporizes Phlegm, removes filth, calms the Spirit, transforms turbid Dampness, harmonizes the Middle Jiao , awakens the Spleen and promotes the movement of Qi .
With Yu Jin and Zhi Ban Xia, for disorientation, irritability, dizziness and hearing problems due to Turbid Dampness Blocking the Orifices.
With Yu Jin, for Transforms Dampness, opens the Orifices and awakens the brain to treat turbid Dampness that has blocked the clear Orifices, with loss of consciousness or confusion, tinnitus and forgetfulness.
Rx. Curcumae
Yu Jin
9g
Activates the Blood, dispels
Blood Stasis, regulates Qi flow, clears the Heart and Pericardium and opens the Orifices.
Rx. Glycyrrhizae
Gan Cao
4.5g
Tonifies
the Spleen, augments Qi , r esolves Phlegm, moderates and harmonizes the harsh properties of other herbs and guides the herbs to all twelve channels .
FORMULA ACTIONS
Regulates Qi
Resolves Phlegm
SYNDROMES
Liver Qi Stagnation: Phlegm and Qi Stagnant and Blocked
CLINICAL MANIFESTATIONS
Dull and silly
Mumbling to oneself
Temperamental
Frequent laughing and crying
Feeling of obstruction in throat as if a slice of roast
meat were stuck there which cannot be coughed up nor
swallowed down. This sensation becomes more prominent
during emotional upset and subsides when relaxed
Distention and pain in the sides or flanks
Suffocating sensation in the chest
Hysteria
Tendency to sigh
Melancholy
Apathy
Depression
Irritability
Inappropriate anger
Irregular menses
Dysmenorrhea
Breast distention and pain before and during menses
Premenstrual syndrome
Chronic cases :
Red eyes
Tidal fever
A dry mouth
T: Pink
C: Thin and white
P: Slippery and wiry (slippery due to Phlegm)
TREATS
Schizophrenia

HERB FORMULAS
SCHIZOPHRENIA #4
English:
Also Known As:
sections.ACTIONS:
Rx. Codonopsis
Dang Shen
9g
Tonifies the Middle Jiao , augments Qi and nourishes the Blood.
With Fu Ling, for Spleen and Stomach Deficiency with fatigue, a sensation of fullness in the abdomen, dizziness, lethargy, shortness of breath, anorexia and loose stools or diarrhea.
Cinnabaris-treated Poria
Zhu Fu Ling
9g
Quiets the Heart, c alms the Spirit, s oothes the nerves and strengthens the Spleen.
With Zhi Ban Xia, prevents turbid Phlegm and Dampness from disturbing the Heart with dizziness, palpitations and insomnia.
With Gan Cao, for Spleen and Heart Deficiency causing facial edema, palpitations
and shortness of breath.
Rx. Salviae Miltiorrhizae
Dan Shen
12g
Activates the Blood, d ispels Blood Stasis , Nourishes the Blood and calms the Spirit.
Rx. Angelicae Sinensis
Dang Gui
9g
Tonifies, activates and harmonizes the Blood.
Rx. Polygalae Preparata
Zhi Yuan Zhi
9g
Calms the Spirit, sedates the Heart , clears the channel joining the Heart and Kidney, expels Phlegm and opens the Orifices.
With Fu Ling and Suan Zao Ren, for irritability, disorientation, palpitations, anxiety and insomnia due to Heart Blood Deficiency or Qi Stagnation.
Dry-fried Sm. Zizyphi Spinosae
Chao Suan Zao Ren
12g
Nourishes the Heart, astringes the Liver, calms the Spirit, facilitates sleep and treats irritable thirst and sweating from Deficiency.
With Yuan Zhi, balances the contracting, introverted and dispersing, extroverted manifestations of Spirit to ensure the proper balance of openness and sobriety.
Rz. Pinelliae Preparatum
Zhi Ban Xia
9g
Dries Dampness, transforms Phlegm and harmonizes the Stomach.
Fr. Tritici Levis
Fu Xiao Mai
30g
Stops excessive sweating due to Deficiency, nourishes the Heart and c alms the Spirit .
With Gan Cao and Da Zao, for emotional disorders, disorientation, emotional instability, and irritability due to mild Deficiency of the Spleen Qi and Heart Blood.
Rx. Glycyrrhizae
Gan Cao
6g
Tonifies
the Spleen, augments Qi , moderates and harmonizes the harsh properties of other herbs and guides the herbs to all twelve channels.
With Dang Shen, for palpitations due to Heart Qi Deficiency.
Fr. Jujube
Da Zao
6g
Tonifies the Spleen and Stomach, augments Qi , nourishes the Blood and c alms the Spirit .
FORMULA ACTIONS
Reinforces and Benefits the Heart and Spleen
Tonifies the Blood
Calms the Shen
SYNDROMES
Heart Blood and Spleen Qi Deficiency
CLINICAL MANIFESTATIONS
Palpitations
Insomnia
Much dreaming
Easily startled
Poor memory
Lack of concentration
Palpitations
Apprehension
Sadness with a desire to cry
Fatigue
Weakness
Four limbs tired and lethargic
Loss of appetite
Distention and fullness of the epigastrium and abdomen
Loose stools
Sallow complexion
Copious, pale menses
Uterine bleeding or
Light menstrual flow or
Amenorrhea
T: Pale
C: Thin and white
P: Thready and weak
TREATS
Schizophrenia

English:
Also Known As:
sections.ACTIONS:
Rx. Gentianae
Long Dan Cao
9g
Drains Damp-Heat from the Liver and Gallbladder channels and drains and pacifies Excess Liver Fire.
Dry-fried Fr. Gardeniae
Zhi Zi
9g
Clears Heat, reduces Fire and resolves Dampness.
Rx. Angelicae Sinensis
Dang Gui
9g
Tonifies, activates and harmonizes the Blood.
Fr. Aurantii Immaturus
Zhi Shi
9g
Breaks up Stagnant Qi , reduces accumulation, descends Qi and t ransforms Phlegm.
Rz. Acori Tatarinowii
Shi Chang Pu
9g
Opens the Orifices, vaporizes Phlegm, removes filth, calms the Spirit, disperses Wind , transforms turbid Dampness, harmonizes the Middle Jiao , awakens the Spleen and promotes the movement of Qi.
With Ci Shi, for tinnitus or diarrhea due to Kidney Deficiency.
Rx. Scutellariae
Huang Qin
9g
Clears Heat, dries Dampness , drains Fire, detoxifies and calms ascending Liver Yang.
With Zhi Zi, for Damp-Heat and jaundice.
Magnetitum
Ci Shi
30g
Anchors Liver Yang, calms the Spirit, benefits Yin, nourishes
the Kidneys and augments the Liver.
Dens Draconis
Long Chi
12g
Settles anxiety, calms the Spirit , calms the Liver and anchors and preserves Floating Yang .
Rz. Pinelliae
Zhi Ban Xia
12g
Dries Dampness and transforms Phlegm.
FORMULA ACTIONS
Purges the Liver
Clears Fire
Sedates the Heart
Resolves Phlegm
SYNDROMES
Liver Fire Generates Phlegm Fire
CLINICAL MANIFESTATIONS
Acute onset
Irascibility
Headaches
A quick temper
Resorts to violence
Abusive language
Destruction of goods
Attacking people
Sudden tinnitus or
Sudden deafness
Flushed face
Red, swollen, painful eyes
Irascibility with violent angry outbursts
Dry mouth
Bitter taste in mouth
Thirst
Vomiting sour or bitter liquid
Insomnia
Restlessness
Constipation or dry stools
Maybe rib pain
In severe cases :
Mania
Hemoptysis
Hematemesis
Epistaxis
T: Red tip and edges or Purplish
C: Thick, yellow, dry and rough
P: Wiry, Excess and rapid

Schizophrenia

+ 9g Rx. et Rz. Rhei
Da Huang
+ 9g Natrii Sulfas
Mang Xiao

HERB FORMULAS
SCHIZOPHRENIA #6
English:
Also Known As:
sections.ACTIONS:
Rx. Scutellariae
Huang Qin
9g
Drains Fire, detoxifies and calms ascending Liver Yang.
With Huang Lian, drains pathogenic Heat from the Upper and Middle Jiaos for redness, swelling and pain of the head and face, a dry mouth, a parched throat, ulcerations of the mouth and tongue.
Rz. Coptidis
Huang Lian
9g
Drains Fire, resolves Fire toxicity, clears Heart Fire and drains Stomach Fire.
Cx. Phellodendri
Huang Bai
9g
Drains Fire, relieves Fire toxicity and drains Kidney Fire.
With Long Gu and Mu Li, for irritability.
Rx. Angelicae Sinensis
Dang Gui
9g
Tonifies, activates and harmonizes the Blood, moistens the Intestines and unblocks the bowels.
Hb. Aloes
Lu Hui
9g
Purges and drains Fire, g uides out accumulations, clears Heat and c ools the Liver.
With Long Dan Cao, Huang Qin and Huang Lian, for Heat in the Liver channel with epigastric pain, dizziness, a headache and irritability.
Rx. Gentianae
Long Dan Cao
9g
Drains and pacifies Excess Liver Fire .
With Huang Lian, for red, swollen, painful eyes due to Excess Heat in the Liver channel.
With Da Huang, for rib pain, a bitter taste, red eyes, deafness, fright, mania and constipation due to Liver Fire.
Rx. et Rz. Rhei
Da Huang
9g
Drains Heat, p urges accumulations, drains Fire, activates the Blood, d ispels Blood Stasis, reduces Fire toxicity and eliminates Phlegm.
With Huang Lian, for distention, Heart palpitations, mental distress with facial congestion and epilepsy due to Excess Heat.
With Dang Gui, for Blood Stasis.
Natrii Sulfas
Mang Xiao
9g
Purges accumulations, guides out Stagnation, softens hardness, moistens Dryness, clears Heat and drains Fire .
With Da Huang, for constipation due to Heat in the Stomach and Intestines.
Rx. Bupleuri
Chai Hu
12g
Spreads Liver Qi , relieves Stagnation , disperses Wind-Heat and r esolves Phlegm and congestion .
With Huang Qin, restores normal functioning of the Liver and Gallbladder.
Fossilia Ossis Mastodi
Long Gu
30g
Settles anxiety, calms the Spirit , calms the Liver and anchors and preserves Floating Yang ,
Concha Ostreae
Mu Li
30g
Heavily settles and calms the Spirit , calms the Liver, benefits Yin and anchors Floating Yang .
Gypsum Fibrosum
Shi Gao
30g
Clears Heat in the Qi Stage, drains Fire, relieves irritability, quenches thirst, c lears Excess Heat from the Lungs and clears Blazing Stomach Fire.
With Zhi Mu , cools Heat in the Yang Ming or Qi Level while protecting Stomach fluids to treat high fever, profuse sweating, insatiable thirst, a red face, aversion to Heat and a large, strong pulse.
With Huang Qi, for coughing with Excess Lung Heat.
Rz. Anemarrhenae
Zhi Mu
6g
Clears Heat, drains Fire from the Lungs and from the Stomach, nourishes Yin , moistens Dryness, generates Fluids, clears Deficiency Fire and quenches thirst.
With Huang Bai, clears Heat and Drains Fire for Yin Deficiency Fire.
With Huang Lian, for Blazing Stomach Fire with intense hunger, dry stools, a dry yellow tongue coat and a slippery rapid pulse.
Rx. Glycyrrhizae
Gan Cao
3g
Clears Heat, r elieves Fire toxicity , moderates and harmonizes the harsh properties of other herbs and guides the herbs to all twelve channels.
FORMULA ACTIONS
Clears Heat
Drains Fire
Purges the Intestines
SYNDROMES
Excess Fire
CLINICAL MANIFESTATIONS
Manic behavior
Raving walking
Shouting
Abusing people
Climbing to high places
Singing
Removing one's clothes
Unusual strength
Foul breath
Red face
Abdominal pain and distention
Constipation
T: Red
C: Dark and yellow or Black and dry
P: Deep and wiry
TREATS
Schizophrenia

SCHIZOPHRENIA #7
English:
Also Known As:
sections.ACTIONS:
Rx. Bupleuri
Chai Hu
15g
Harmonizes the Exterior and Interior, spreads Liver Qi and relieves Stagnation.
With Huang Qin, restores the normal function of the Liver and Gallbladder.
With Huang Qi and Zhi Ban Xia , for Shao Yang disorders with alternating chills and fever and a sensation of fullness in the hypochondria and chest.
Fossilia Ossis Mastodi
Long Gu
30g
Settles anxiety, calms the Spirit , calms the Liver and anchors and preserves Floating Yang .
(Magnetitum)
( Ci Shi )
(30g)
(Anchors Liver Yang, calms the Spirit Benefits Yin, nourishes
the Kidneys, augments the Liver and improves
hearing and vision - May be used instead of Long Gu. )
(With Long Gu and Mu Li , for dizziness and vertigo associated with Yin Deficiency with Yang Rising.)
Concha Ostreae
Mu Li
30g
Heavily settles and calms the Spirit , c alms the Liver, benefits Yin and anchors Floating Yang .
With Chai Hu, Dan Shen and Chi Shao, for sub-costal pain and swelling.
Bamboo-treated Rz. Pinelliae Preparatum
Zhi Ban Xia
9g
Dries Dampness, transforms Phlegm and descends Rebellious Qi .
With Chen Pi, for epigastric and abdominal distention or pain due to disharmony of the Stomach Qi .
With Huang Qin, for Phlegm-Heat induced Rebellious Qi with cough, nausea, and vomiting.
Rx. Scutellariae
Huang Qin
9g
Clears Heat, dries Dampness Drains Fire and detoxifies and c alms ascending Liver Yang .
With Chai Hu, for Heat in the Shao Yang with alternating chills and fever and nausea.
With Da Huang, for constipation.
Sm. Persicae
Tao Ren
15g
Breaks up Blood Stasis, activates Blood circulation, moistens the Intestines and unblocks the bowels.
With Hong Hua, activates the Blood for all types of Blood Stagnation.
Flos Carthami
Hong Hua
9g
Activates the Blood, dispels Blood Stasis, opens the channels and alleviates pain.
Rx. Salviae Miltiorrhizae
Dan Shen
15g
Activates the Blood, d ispels Blood Stasis, clears Heat, soothes irritability, n ourishes the Blood and calms the Spirit.
Cx. Moutan
Mu Dan Pi
15g
Clears Heat, cools and harmonizes the Blood , clears Deficiency Fire, activates the Blood, dispels Blood Stasis and clears Liver Fire.
With Chi Shao, for Blood Stasis disorders.
Rx. Paeoniae Rubra
Chi Shao
15g
Activates the Blood, d ispels Blood Stasis , relieves pain, clears Liver Fire and relieves eye pain.
With Xiang Fu, for flank pain, abdominal pain, and dysmenorrhea due to Qi and Blood Stagnation.
Rz. Cyperi
Xiang Fu
15g
Spreads and regulates Liver Qi .
With Chai Hu, for Qi Stagnation and menstrual irregularity.
Per. Citri Reticulatae Viride
Qing Pi
15g
Spreads and breaks up Stagnant Liver Qi, dries Dampness and t ransforms Phlegm .
With Xiang Fu, for pain and distention of the flanks due to Liver Qi Stagnation.
With Chai Hu, restores the Qi circulation between the Upper and Lower Jiaos to treat long-term Qi Stagnation moving to Blood Stasis.
Per. Citri Reticulatae
Chen Pi
15g
Regulates Qi , adjusts the Middle, descends Qi , r elieves the diaphragm, dries Dampness and t ransforms Phlegm.
With Qing Pi, for flank pain and chest and abdominal distention due to Liver Qi Stagnation.
With Zhi Ban Xia, for a stifling sensation in the chest.
Wine-fried Rx. et Rz. Rhei
Jiu Xi Da Huang
15g
Cools upper Jiao Fire and directs it downward to treat Large Intestine Heat toxin.
With Chi Shao, for chronic accumulation in the abdomen, blockage of urine,
constipation, Qi rushing upward to the Heart, abdominal
distention and rebellious damage from food and drink.
Rx. Glycyrrhizae
Gan Cao
9g
Moderates and harmonizes the harsh properties of other herbs and guides the herbs to all twelve channels .
FORMULA ACTIONS
Regulates Qi
Activates the Blood
Breaks up Blood Stasis
Calms the Shen
SYNDROMES
Qi and Blood Stagnation
CLINICAL MANIFESTATIONS
Facial color dark and dull
Emaciation
Sides and ribs distended on both sides (maybe with
sharp pain)
Enlargement of the Liver and Spleen
Suffocating sensation in chest
Tendency to sigh
Melancholy
Depression
Irritability
Inappropriate anger
Irregular menses
Dysmenorrhea
Breast distention and pain
before and during menses
T: Dark purple (maybe purple
spots on edge of tongue)
P: Wiry, choppy and slow
TREATS
Schizophrenia
sections.NOTES: Rz. Pinelliae Preparatum Zhi Ban Xia is treated with the exudate of Bambusae in Taeniam Zhu Ru .

SCHIZOPHRENIA #8
English:
Also Known As:
sections.ACTIONS:
Rx. Aconiti Lateralis Preparata
Zhi Fu Zi
6g
Warms Ming Men Fire and assists Heart, Kidney and Spleen Yang .
With Gan Jiang, warms the Spleen and Kidneys, benefits Yang and disperses Cold.
With Gan Jiang and Gan Cao, for for Cold extremities and diarrhea with undigested food due to Collapse of the Spleen and Kidney Yang .
With Rou Gui and Shu Di Huang, for Kidney Yang Deficiency with waning of Ming Men Fire with aversion to Cold, weak and sore back and legs, impotence and urinary frequency.
With Huang Qi, for spontaneous sweat and chills due to Yang Deficiency.
With Rou Gui, powerfully tonifies Kidney Yang, for Kidney Yang Deficiency with lower back pain and weakness in the legs and knees
and deficiency of Ming Men Fire with impotence or infertility.
Cx. Cinnamomi
Rou Gui
6g
Warms the Kidneys, Spleen and Heart, strengthens Yang and Ming Men Fire, disperses deep Cold, w arms
the channels, unbloc ks the channels and
vessels and alleviates pain .
Rz. Zingiberis
Gan Jiang
6g
Warms the Middle and e xpels Interior Cold .
With Zhi Fu Zi, for debilitated Spleen and Kidney Yang with incessant diarrhea.
With Gan Cao, for epigastric pain and vomiting due to Spleen and Stomach Deficiency Cold.
Rx. Morindae
Ba Ji Tian
9g
Tonifies the Kidneys and strengthens Yang .
Hb. Epimedii
Yin Yang Huo
9g
Tonifies the Kidneys,
strengthens Yang , increases the libido and unblocks the flow of Yang Qi.
With Xian Mao, accentuates the effects of the herb.
Rz. Curculiginis
Xian Mao
9g
Tonifies the Kidneys and strengthens Yang .
With Yin Yang Huo, for Chills and impotence with Cold sperm, cold extremities and infertility.
Rx. Astragali
Huang Qi
9g
Tonifies Qi and Blood, strengthens the Spleen and raises the Yang Qi of the Spleen and Stomach.
With Zhi Fu Zi, for Yang Deficiency with spontaneous sweating.
Per. Citri Reticulatae
Chen Pi
9g
Regulates and descends Q i , adjusts the Middle, relieves the diaphragm, dries Dampness, transforms Phlegm and helps prevent Stagnation from tonic herbs.
Rx. Codonopsis
Dang Shen
6g
Tonifies the Middle Jiao , augments Qi, nourishes the Blood and promotes the generation of Body Fluids.
With Huang Qi, for Lung and Spleen Qi Deficiency with fatigue, shortness of breath, diarrhea and anorexia.
Rx, Rehmanniae Preparata
Shu Di Huang
15g
Nourishes Jing and Blood, fills the Marrow and nourishes Liver and Kidney Yin .
With Zhi Fu Zi and Rou Gui, for Kidney Yang Deficiency.
Plastrum Testudinis
Gui Ban
15g
Nourishes Yin ,
anchors Yang , benefits the Kidneys , nourishes the Blood, enriches Yin and tonifies the Heart.
Fr. Amomi
Sha Ren
3g
Promotes the movement of Qi, aromatically transforms Dampness, strengthens the Spleen, warms the Middle, stops diarrhea and prevents Stagnation from tonic herbs .
With Chen Pi, assists the digestion of greasy tonic herbs.
With Zhi Fu Zi and Gan Jiang, for Cold-Damp diarrhea.
Rx. Glycyrrhizae
Gan Cao
3g
Moderates and harmonizes the harsh properties of other herbs and guides the herbs to all twelve channels .
FORMULA ACTIONS
Tonifies the Kidneys
Warms Yang
SYNDROMES
Yang Deficiency
CLINICAL MANIFESTATIONS
Dull emotional expression
Dull eyes
A decrease in self-initiated activity
Talks little
Sentences have little content or are unfinished
Slow response
Poor hygiene
Loss of concentration
Decreased sex drive
Loner behavior
Low excitability
Disregard of social codes
Extremely cold extremities
Aversion to Cold
Sleeping with knees drawn up
Lethargy with a constant desire to sleep
Vomiting
Diarrhea with undigested food
Abdominal pain and Cold
Lack of thirst
Coma
Indigestion
Edema
Pale face
Superficial fever
Red face
Cyanosis of the lips and nails

Nourishes the Blood, preserves Yin , softens the Liver and alleviates pain.

HERB FORMULAS
SHENG MAI YIN WAN - 生脉饮片 - REPLENISH
PULSE PILLS
English:
Replenish Pulse
Pills
Also Known As:
sections.ACTIONS:
Rx. Ginseng
Ren Shen
1-9g
Tonifies Yuan, Spleen,
Stomach, Lung and Heart Qi, generates Body Fluids and
s tops thirst .
With Mai Men Dong and Wu Wei Zi, for Qi and Yin Deficiency
with shortness of breath and spontaneous sweating usually secondary
to injury from Heat.
Rx. Ophiopogonis
Mai Men Dong
6-15g
Moistens the Lungs, nourishes Yin,
s tops cough , nourishes Stomach Yin, g enerates
fluids clears the Heart
and e liminates irritability.
Fr. Schisandrae
Wu Wei Zi
1.5-9g
Astringes leakage of Lung Qi , stops
cough, astringes sweat, generates fluids, tonifies
the Kidneys , astringes Jing , stops diarrhea and
spermatorrhea, quiets the Spirit and calms and contains Heart Qi.
With Mai Men Dong, for
exhaustion of Qi and Yin with shortness of
breath, cough, and thirst
and spontaneous night sweats with Qi Deficiency.
Rx. Salviae Miltiorrhizae
Dan Shen
3-15g
Invigorates the Blood, d ispels
Blood Stasis , clears Heat, soothes irritability, nourishes
the Blood and calms the Spirit.
FORMULA ACTIONS
Replenishes Qi and Yin
Generates Body Fluids
SYNDROMES
Lung Qi and Yin Deficiency
CLINICAL MANIFESTATIONS
Chronic cough or
Dry cough
Insomnia
Night sweats
Spontaneous perspiration
Weakness
Palpitations
Shortness of breath
Fever
Irritability
T: Red and dry or Red and swollen
C: Little or None
P: Thready and weak

Acute collapse
Pulmonary tuberculosis
Myocarditis

perspiration

Insomnia

sections.CONTRAINDICATIONS:
Use with extreme caution in cases with high fever.
Use with extreme caution when External
pathogenic factors have not been eliminated.

English:
Mysterious Decoction
Also Known As:
Ma Huang and Magnolia Combination
sections.ACTIONS:
Hb. Ephedrae
Ma Huang
5-6g
Induces sweating, releases the Exterior , warms and disperses Cold pathogens, disseminates and facilitates Lung Qi, calms wheezing and stops coughing.
With Xing Ren, for Wind-Cold cough and wheezing.
With Xing Ren, Chen Pi and Hou Po, for wheezing and dyspnea due to Qi and Phlegm Stagnation.
Sm. Armeniacae
Xing Ren
4-6g
Stops cough and calms wheezing .
Per. Citri Reticulatae
Chen Pi
2.5-3g
Regulates and descends Qi , adjusts the Middle, relieves the diaphragm , dries Dampness and
t ransforms Phlegm.
Cx. Magnoliae Officinalis
Hou Po
3-6g
Descends Rebellious Qi , dries Dampness, reduces Phlegm and calms wheezing.
With Xing Ren, strongly descends Qi, disperses Phlegm-Dampness
and calms wheezing to treat cough and wheezing from Phlegm-Dampness
leading to Lung Qi Stagnation.
With Ma Huang and Xing Ren, for cough and wheezing with copious sputum due to congested fluids.
Fol. Perillae
Zi Su Ye
1.5-3g
Releases the Exterior and d isperses Cold , relieves Cold induced wheezing, harmonizes the Middle Jiao and relieves intestinal gas.
Rx. Bupleuri
Chai Hu
2-3g
Disperses Wind-Heat, r esolves Phlegm and congestion , spreads Liver Qi and relieves Stagnation.
With Gan Cao, for Wind-Heat fever.

Gan Cao
2-3g
Moistens the Lungs, r esolves Phlegm, s tops cough, moderates and harmonizes the harsh properties of other herbs and guides the herbs to all twelve channels .
With Ma Huang and Xing Ren, for coughing or wheezing due to Wind-Cold Attacks the Lungs.

Maybe low back pain
Maybe frozen shoulder

Cough

COPD
Abdominal weakness
Gasping

HERB FORMULAS
SHEN SHENG FU ZI TANG - 參升 附子湯 - GINSENG, CIMICIFUGA AND PREPARED ACONITE DECOCTION
English:
Ginseng, Cimicifuga and Aconite Prepared Decoction
Also Known As:
sections.ACTIONS:
Rx. Aconiti Lateralis Preparata
Zhi Fu Zi
9g
Warms Ming Men Fire, assists Heart, Kidney and Spleen Yang , disperses Cold and Dampness, warms the channels and stops pain.
With Gan Jiang, warms the Spleen and Kidneys, benefits Yang , and disperses Cold for
overabundance of Yin fluids due to Deficiency Cold.
With Ren Shen, for severe Deficiency of the Source Qi and Collapse of Yang .
With Huang Qi, for spontaneous sweat and chills due to Yang Deficiency.
With Xi Xin, disperses Cold and stops pain.
Rz. Zingiberis
Gan Jiang
9g
Warms the Lungs, t ransforms thin mucus, warms the Middle, e xpels Cold and dispels Wind-Dampness seeping into the Lower Jiao.
With Gan Cao, for epigastric pain and vomiting due to Spleen and Stomach Deficiency Cold.
With Ren Shen and Zhi Ban Xia, for vomiting due to Deficiency Cold.
Rx. Saposhnikoviae
Fang Feng
15g
Expels Wind-Dampness and a lleviates pain .
With Huang Qi, prevents Wind from entering the skin.
Sm. Pruni
Yu Li Ren
15g
Moistens the Intestines, unblocks
the bowels, promotes urination and r educes edema.
Rx. Ginseng
Ren Shen
15g
Powerfully tonifies Yuan Qi and tonifies Lung Qi .
With Huang Qi, for Lung Qi Deficiency.
Rx. Angelicae Sinensis
Dang Gui
18g
Tonifies, invigorates and harmonizes the Blood,
disperses Cold, regulates the menses, stops cough and treats dyspnea.
With Huang Qi, for Qi and Blood Deficiency.
With Shu Di Huang, for Heat symptoms due to Yin Deficiency and Devastated Blood.
With Ju Pi and Zhi Ban Xia, for Lung and Kidney Yin Deficiency with overflowing
water turning to Phlegm, with cough, wheezing, nausea marked
by profuse and salty sputum.
Rz. Pinelliae Preparatum
Zhi Ban Xia
21g
Dries Dampness transforms Phlegm and harmonizes the stomach .
With Gan Jiang, for vomiting due to Cold with copious, frothy sputum with Cold signs and thin mucus in the Lungs.
With Ren Shen, for vomiting due to Stomach Deficiency.
With Huang Lian, for Cold and Heat in the Middle Jiao with abdominal fullness, nausea and vomiting.
Rz. Cimicifugae
Sheng Ma
21g
Releases the Exterior, clears Heat, relieves toxicity, raises Yang and lifts sunken Qi.
With Huang Lian, for ulcers of the gums and mouth with bad breath.
Rx. Glycyrrhizae
Gan Cao
24g
Tonifies
the Spleen, augments Qi, r esolves Phlegm, s tops cough, Clears Heat, r elieves Fire toxicity and moderates and harmonizes the harsh properties of other herbs.
Rx. et Rz. Ligustici
Gao Ben
24g
Expels Wind and Cold Dispels Wind-Dampness and alleviates pain.
With Xi Xin, for Wind-Cold-Damp headache, vertex headaches, stiff neck and toothaches.
With Chuan Xiong and Xi Xin, for headache due to Cold and Dampness.
Rx. Bupleuri
Chai Hu
30g
Harmonizes the Exterior and Interior, spreads Liver Qi , relieves Stagnation, raises Yang Qi and r esolves Phlegm and congestion .
With Zhi Ke, for a stifling sensation in the chest, abdominal pain, poor appetite, and irregular bowel movements.
With Huang Qi, raises the Clear Yang due to abnormal descent of Qi .
With Huang Qi, Sheng Ma and Ren Shen , for Central Qi Sinking.
Flos Althaeae Rosae
Shu Gui Hua
15g
Moistens the skin, astringes, protects mucous membranes, expels Phlegm, cools Heat, reduces inflammation, detoxifies, activates the Blood in the Lower Jiao and alleviates pain.
Per. Citri Reticulatae
Ju Pi
15g
Circulates Qi , disperses knots, and stops pain.
Rx. Astragali
Huang Qi
30g
Tonifies Qi and Blood, tonifies Wei Qi , stabilizes the Exterior, tonifies the Lungs, aids circulation of moisture downward from the face, promotes urination and reduces edema.
Rx. Rehmanniae Preparata
Shu Di Huang
6g
Nourishes Liver and Kidney Yin, nourishes Jing and Blood and a rrests cough and wheezing.
With Ren Shen, for
Qi, Blood and Yin Deficiency.
Cx. Phellodendri
Huang Bai
9g
Drains Damp-Heat especially from the Lower Jiao, drains Kidney Fire and relieves Fire toxicity.
With Xi Xin, for urinary frequency, urgency, discomfort, and
pain.
Rz. Coptidis
Huang Lian
9g
Clears Heat, drains Dampness and resolves Fire toxicity.
With Zhi Ban Xia and Gan Jiang, for Cold and Heat complexes in the Intestines and Stomach marked by focal distention, nausea, vomiting and feelings of oppression in the chest.
With Xi Xi, for Swollen eyes and deafness.
Fr. Aurantii
Zhi Ke
9g
Promotes the movement of Qi and reduces distention and pressure.
With Sheng Ma, relaxes the bowels and encourages the downward flow of turbid Yin .
Rx. Asari
Xi Xin
6g
Expels Wind and Cold , warms the Lungs, transforms Phlegm and Thin Mucus and circulates water.
Rz. Chuanxiong
Chuan Xiong

SHEN XIAO GUA LOU SAN
- 神效栝楼散 - SPIRIT-LIKE EFFECT TRICHOSANTHIS POWDER
English:
Spirit-Like Effect
Trichosanthis Powder
Also Known As:
sections.ACTIONS:
Fr. Trichosanthis
Gua Lou
9-30g
Transforms Hot Phlegm, reduces
abscesses, dissipates nodules and eliminates pus.
With Ru Xiang , invigorates Qi and Blood to disperse
swellings and clumps and treat puerperal breast disorders with accumulation,
Stagnation, distention and pain such as insufficient lactation from
obstruction or early-stage breast abscess With Ru Xiang and Mo
Yao, for Lung abscess
marked by irritability, stifling sensation in the chest, and coughing
up of pus and blood.
Rx. Glycyrrhizae
Gan Cao
6-14g
Clears Heat, r esolves
Phlegm and r elieves
Fire toxicity .
Rx. Angelicae Sinensis
Dang Gui
3-15g
Tonifies, invigorates
and harmonizes the Blood, disperses Cold, r educes
swelling, expels pus, generates flesh and alleviates pain.
Olibanum
Ru Xiang
3-15g
Invigorates the Blood, promotes
the movement of Qi , reduces
swelling, g enerates flesh and
allevi ates pain.
With Mo Yao, for chronic, ulcerated and non-healing
sores.
Myrrh
Mo Yao
3-12g
Invigorates the Blood, d ispels
Blood Stasis, allevia tes
pain, r educes
swelling, generates flesh and promotes healing.
With Ru Xiang, for swollen, painful sores and
sores that are hard but not painful.
FORMULA ACTIONS
Reduces abscesses
Dissipates nodules
Eliminates pus
Clears
Heat
Relieves
Fire toxicity
Tonifies, invigorates
and harmonizes the Blood
Alleviates pain
SYNDROMES
Toxic sores
CLINICAL MANIFESTATIONS
Initial Stage :
Postpartum breast swelling and pain
Difficulty breast feeding
Cracked nipple
Localized burning
Heat
Maybe redness
Palpable nodular lumps which are worse with pressure
Aversion to Cold
Fever
Anhidrosis
Headache
Muscular soreness and pain
Whole body joint pain
Chest oppression
T: Normal
C: Thin and yellow or Thin and white
P: Floating and rapid or Floating and tight
Suppurative Stage :
Discharge of pus from the breast
Gradual return of normal body
temperature
Relief from severe aversion to Cold
Relief from fever
Disappearance of swelling and pain
Gradual healing of the superficial lesions
May still be redness of the breast with pain
* If there are lesions, there may be a thick, yellowish exudate
with itch around the affected (this is a sign of healing)
*If there
are multiple lesions with heartburn, nausea and vomiting, recovery
may be difficult
*
If there are ulcerous lesions surrounded by dark
flesh with pain radiating to the Heart and a thin, weak constitution,
the condition may be critical
T: Pink
C: Thin and yellow
P: Rapid or Weak
TREATS
Mastitis
Breast cancer
sections.NOTES: Take as a decoction with one teacup of aged wine.

HERB FORMULAS
SHI QUAN DA BU TANG -
十全大補湯 - ALL INCLUSIVE GREAT TONIFYING
DECOCTION
English:
All-Inclusive Great Tonifying Decoction
Also Known As:
Ten Complete Great Tonification Decoction
The Tonification Decoction with Ten Ingredients
Ginseng and Dang Gui Ten Combination
sections.ACTIONS:
Rx. Astragali
Huang Qi
6-10g
Strengthens the Spleen, tonifies Qi and nourishes Blood.
With Ren Shen , for Qi Deficiency.
With Bai Zhu , for Spleen Qi Deficiency.
With Dang Gui , for Qi and Blood Deficiencies.
With Dang Gui, Shu Di Huang, Ren Shen, Bai Zhu and Rou Gui, for flat sores that do not pustulate or ulcers that do not heal.
Cx. Cinnamomi
Rou Gui
3-6g
Warms Kidneys, strengthens Yang and assists the generation of Qi and Blood.
With Huang Qi and Dang Gui, for Yin -type boils due to Qi and Blood Deficiencies especially those that form but do not ulcerate.
With Dang Gui and Chuan Xiong, for dysmenorrhea, postpartum abdominal pain or amenorrhea due to Deficiency Cold of the Chong and Ren channels.
Rx. Ginseng
Ren Shen
6-9g
Tonifies Yuan Qi and Qi of the Spleen, Lungs and Heart.
With Shu Di Huang, for dysmenorrhea, postpartum abdominal pain or amenorrhea due to Deficiency Cold of the Chong and Ren channel.
With Bai Zhu, tonifies the transformation and transportation functions of the Spleen.
With Bai Zhu and Fu Ling, for Spleen and Stomach Qi Deficiencies with Dampness with anorexia, diarrhea, vomiting, abdominal distention and fatigue.
Rx. Rehmanniae Preparata
Shu Di Huang
9-15g
Tonifies the Blood, nourishes Yin, nourishes Jing and fills the Marrow .
With Dang Gui and Bai Shao , for dizziness, palpitations, insomnia and menstrual dysfunction due to Blood Deficiency.
With Dang Gui, Bai Shao and Chuan Xiong, for anemia.
With Ren Shen, Bai Zhu, Fu Ling, Dang Gui and Bai Shao, for anemia with fatigue and weakness.
Rz. Atractylodes Macrocephalae
Bai Zhu
9-12g
Tonifies the Spleen, tonifies Qi , dries Dampness and promotes water metabolism .
With Ren Shen and Huang Qi, for Restless fetus due to Qi Deficiency.
With Shu Di Huang, Dang Gui and Bai Shao, for restless fetus due to Blood Deficiency, often with palpitations.
With Fu Ling and Gan Cao, for Spleen and Stomach Qi Deficiencies.
With Bai Shao, Shu Di Huang and Chuan Xiong , for menstrual irregularity, amenorrhea, and dysmenorrhea due to Blood Deficiency.
With Fu Ling, Ren Shen and Huang Qi, for unstable pregnancy with severe Qi Deficiency.
Rx. Angelicae Sinensis
Dang Gui
9-12g
Tonifies the Blood, regulates the menses, invigorates and harmonizes the Blood, moistens the Intestines, unblocks the bowels, reduces swelling, expels pus, generates flesh and alleviates pain .
With Huang Qi , for Qi and Blood Deficiencies, pallor, debility, fatigue and/or low grade fever due to excessive blood loss
and ulcerated abscesses with insufficient drainage or which drain a clear thin discharge.
With Bai Shao , nourishes, regulates and harmonizes Qi and Blood.
With Bai Shao, Shu Di Huang and Chuan Xiong, for menstrual irregularity, amenorrhea, and dysmenorrhea due to Blood Deficiency or Blood Stasis.
With Shu Di Huang, for Heat symptoms due to Yin Deficiency and Devastated Blood.
With Gan Cao, moderates spasms and relieves abdominal pain.
With Bai Shao and Fu Ling, for diarrhea during pregnancy with mild abdominal pain.
With Chuan Xiong, harmonizes, nourishes and invigorates the Blood and disperses Blood Stasis.
With Ren Shen, Bai Zhu, Shu Di Huang and Bai Shao, for general menstrual disorders with fatigue and weakness due to Qi and Blood Deficiencies.
Rx. Paeoniae Alba
Bai Shao
6-9g
Nourishes Blood and regulates menstruation.
With Gan Cao , for muscle spasms, especially in the calf, due to Blood Deficiency.
Rx. Chuanxiong
Chuan Xiong
3-6g
Activates Blood and regulates Qi .
With Rou Gui, for irregular menstruation with Cold in the Blood.
Poria
Fu Ling
6-9g
Promotes urination, resolves Dampness and strengthens the Spleen.
With Bai Zhu , strengthens the Spleen and resolves Dampness.
With Gan Cao, for Spleen and Heart Deficiencies causing facial edema, palpitations, and shortness of breath.
Rx. Glycyrrhizae
Gan Cao
3-6g
Tonifies the Spleen, tonifies Qi and moderates and harmonizes the properties of other herbs.
With Ren Shen, relieves palpitations and anxiety.

sections.CONTRAINDICATIONS:
Contraindicated for those with Heat or Excess disorders.
HERB/DRUG INTERACTIONS
This formula may have a marked protective effect against chemotherapy- and radiation-induced toxicities.
This formula may have a marked protective effect against cyclophosphamide- or prednisone-induced immuno-suppression.
This formula may have a marked protective effect against carboplatin- or cisplatin-induced myclosuppression.
This formula may have a marked protective effect against cis-diamminedichloroplatinum-induced nephrotoxicity and bone marrow toxicity.
This formula may have a marked protective effect against interferon toxicity.
This formula may have a marked protective effect against rifampin-induced neutropenia.

Da Huang

50g

HERB FORMULAS
SI LING SAN - 四苓散 - FOUR
sections.INGREDIENTS:
English:
Four-Ingredient Formula with Poria
Also Known As:
Hoelen Four Herb Formula
Powder of Four Drugs Containing Poria
sections.ACTIONS:
Rz. Alismatis
Ze Xie
4-15g
Promotes urination, resolves Dampness, strengthens the Spleen, harmonizes the Middle Jiao and transforms Phlegm.
Poria
Fu Ling
2.3-15g
Leeches out Dampness due to deficiency, promotes urination, strengthens the Spleen, and assists the Yang .
With Zhu Ling, promotes urination.
With Bai Zhu , strengthens the Spleen and promotes urination.
With Gui Zhi warms and transforms fluids, unblocks Yang and promotes urination.
With Ze Xie, Gui Zhi and Bai Zhu for Dampness Obstruction causing Lin Syndrome, edema, heaviness of the body, and irritability.
Scl. Polypori
Zhu Ling
2.3-15g
Promotes urination, leaches out Dampness and dispels Heat.
With Ze Xie , drains Damp, unblocks and drains urinary pathways and drains Heat from the Bladder.
Rz. Atractylodis Macrocephalae
Bai Zhu
2.3-10g
Strengthens the Spleen, aids transformation and transportation of fluids and resolves Dampness
With Fu Ling and Gui Zhi , for Spleen Deficiency with chest distention and edema.
FORMULA ACTIONS
Regulates water circulation
Drains Dampness
Strengthens the Spleen
SYNDROMES
Uncomplicated Spleen Deficiency Edema leading to Dampness in the Bladder
Interior Dampness due to inappropriate diet
CLINICAL MANIFESTATIONS
Loose stools
Urinary difficulty
Scanty urination
T: Normal
C: Slippery and white
P: Floating and rapid
TREATS

sections.CONTRAINDICATIONS:
With Spleen Qi and Kidney Deficiency limit dosage, may combine with tonics.
For urinary difficulty with Yin Deficiency, protect Yin .
Overdose symptoms include - dizziness, vertigo, a bland taste and anorexia.
Avoid long term administration.
Contraindicated for those with depleted body fluids from profuse perspiration.
Contraindicated for those with excessive vomiting.
Contraindicated for those with excessive diarrhea.
Contraindicated for those with Damp-Heat Accumulation.

HERB FORMULAS
SI MIAO YONG AN TANG - 四妙勇安湯 - FOUR-VALIENT DECOCTION FOR WELL BEING
English:
Four-Valiant Decoction for Well Being
Also Known As:
Decoction of Four Wonderful Herbs for Quick Restoration of Health
Decoction for Thromboangitis with Four Effective Ingredients
sections.ACTIONS:
Flos Lonicerae
Jin Yin Hua
20-90g
Clears Heat and relieves toxicity.
With Gan Cao, for toxic swellings and sores.
With Gan Cao and Xuan Shen, for sloughing ulcers from Heat toxicity.
With Dang Gui, reduces obstruction and toxicity for swollen, painful sores and necrosis of surrounding tissue.
Rx. Scrophulariae
Xuan Shen
20-90g
Clears Heat, cools the Blood, nourishes Yin , drains Fire and relieves toxicity.
With Jin Yin Hua and Gan Cao , for boils, carbuncles and furuncles.
Rx. Angelicae Sinensis
Dang Gui
10-90g
Nourishes, invigorates and harmonizes Blood, reduces swelling, expels pus, generates flesh and alleviates pain.
Rx. Glycyrrhizae
Gan Cao
5-90g
Clears Heat, relieves Fire toxicity, alleviates pain and moderates and harmonizes the properties of other herbs.
With Jin Yin Hua, for Damp rashes or acne.
FORMULA ACTIONS
Clears Heat
Resolves toxicity
Nourishes Yin
Invigorates the Blood
Alleviates pain
SYNDROMES
Fire Toxin leading to Blood Stasis in the sinews and Blood vessels
CLINICAL MANIFESTATIONS
Ulcerated sores that do not heal on a limb that is dark red
Slightly swollen and warm to the touch
There may me a rotten smell to the lesion
Gangrene of the extremities, especially the fingers and toes with purulent abscess
Extreme pain
Local inflammation and swelling
There may be copious discharge of pus from the ulcers
A burning sensation
Fever
Thirst
T: Red
C: Normal
P: Rapid
TREATS
Acute thrombotic phlebitis
Thromboangitis obliterans
Iliofemoral vein thrombosis
Chronic hepatitis
Viral hepatitis
Sciatica
Carpal tunnel syndrome
Erysipelas
Radio-dermatitis
Thrombophlebitis
Sloughing ulcer
Gangrene
Arterosclerotic gangrene
Chronic gastritis
Benign prostatic hypertrophy
Gout
Varicose veins of the lower limbs
Vascular Bi
Cirrhosis of the Liver
Erythema nodosum
sections.CONTRAINDICATIONS:
Contraindicated for those with Cold, Qi Deficiency or Blood Deficiency.
Avoid scratching the affected area while taking this formula.
HERB/DRUG INTERACTIONS
sections.NOTES: This condition may be attributed to long standing Kidney Deficiency, Wind-Cold-Damp Bi , overindulgence in rich, greasy or spicy foods or improper use of Yang Tonics. More than one factor is usually involved.

HERB FORMULAS
SI NI TANG - 四逆湯 - FRIGID
EXTREMITIES DECOCTION
English:
Frigid Extremities Decoction
Also Known As:
Decoction to Treat Cold Limbs
Aconite, Ginger and Licorice Combination
Aconite and G.L. Combination
sections.ACTIONS:
Rx. Aconiti Lateralis Preparata
Zhi Fu Zi
9g
Warms the Kidney and Heart Yang , stimulates exhausted Yang , warms the Ming Men Fire and the entire body by traveling through all twelve channels.
With Gan Jiang , strengthens the Kidney and Spleen Yang, warms the Spleen and Kidneys, disperses Cold and treats overabundance of Yin fluids due to Deficiency Cold, Devastated Yang and debilitated Spleen and Kidney Yang with incessant diarrhea.
With Gan Jiang and Zhi Gan Cao strengthens the actions of fortifying Qi and benefiting the Yang for Cold extremities and diarrhea with undigested food due to Collapse of the Spleen and Kidney Yang.
(Rx. Aconiti Lateralis)
(Sheng Fu Zi)
(1 piece)
(Use only if condition is critical.)
Rz. Zingiberis
Gan Jiang
4.5g
Warms the Middle Jiao and Lungs, t ransforms thin mucus, e xpels Cold, rescues Yang, warms the channels (unblocks the pulse) and s tops bleeding .
With Zhi Fu Zi, for Cold-Damp Bi.
With Zhi Gan Cao , for epigastric pain and vomiting due to Spleen and Stomach Deficiency Cold and detoxifies Zhi Fu Zi.
Rx. Glycyrrhizae Preparata
Zhi Gan Cao
6g
Tonifies Qi , strengthens the Spleen and moderates the drying properties of the formula.
FORMULA ACTIONS
Rescues Yang
Warms the Middle Jiao
Disperses Internal Cold
Stops diarrhea
SYNDROMES
Heart Yang Deficiency Exhaustion: Yang Xu Jue Ni
Kidney Yang Deficiency with Internal Cold
Shao Yin Cold
Yang Ming Han
Excess use of diaphoretics in Tai Yang Stage leading to loss of Yang

Aversion to Cold

infarction

sections.CONTRAINDICATIONS:
Contraindicated for those with True Heat with False Cold (C.M.: cold extremities, thirst with a desire for cold drinks, dark urine, T: Red, C: Yellow).
Stop this formula immediately once the hands and feet have warmed up.

SINUSITIS #1
English:
Also Known As:
sections.ACTIONS:
Flos Lonicerae
Jin Yin Hua
30g
Clears Heat and resolves Fire toxicity and vents and disperses External Wind-Heat.
With Huang Qin, for suppurating boils that have not ulcerated, or have ulcerated but are not discharging pus.
With Dang Gui, reduces obstruction and toxicity for swollen, painful sores and necrosis of surrounding tissue.
Hb. Taraxaci
Pu Gong Ying
30g
Reduces abscesses, dissipates nodules, relieves Fire toxicity and clears Heat in the Blood.
Rx. Scutellariae
Huang Qin
12g
Clears Heat, dries Dampness, drains Fire and detoxifies.
Fol. Isatidis
Da Qing Ye
15g
Clears Heat and resolves Fire toxicity.
With Jin Yin Hua, for toxic Heat sores, erysipelas, mumps, or sore throat.
Fr. Xanthii
Cang Er Zi
15g
Disperses Wind and Dampness and opens nasal passages.
With Xin Yi Hua, for blocked nose due to Wind-Cold
and chronic sinusitis.
Hb. Asari
Xi Xin
4g
Releases Exterior Wind and Cold, warms the Lungs, transforms Phlegm and Thin Mucus and disperses and unblocks the Qi of the nasal orifices.
Gypsum Fibrosum
Shi Gao
30g
Clears Heat in the Qi Stage, drains Fire, relieves irritability, quenches thirst, clears Excess Heat from the Lungs and clears Blazing Stomach Fire.
With Xi Xin, for toothache and gum swelling due to Blazing Stomach Fire.
Rx. Angelicae Sinensis
Dang Gui
12g
Tonifies Blood, invigorates and harmonizes the Blood, disperses Cold, moistens the Intestines and unblocks the bowels.
Flos Magnoliae
Xin Yi Hua
9g
Expels Wind-Cold and u nblocks the nasal passages.
With Cang Er Zi, strongly unblocks nasal obstruction and sinus headache due to Wind-Cold or Wind-Heat for sinusitis and rhinitis with loss of sense of smell.
With Xi Xin, lifts and spreads the clear Qi while unblocking the nasal orifices to treat headache and sinus distention, nasal congestion and thick nasal discharge due to Wind-Cold
and with cooling herbs, for Wind-Heat.
Hb. Houttuyniae
Yu Xing Cao
30g
Clears Heat, relieves toxicity, reduces swellings and abscesses and expels pus (acts especially on the Lungs).
FORMULA ACTIONS
Clears Heat and Fire
Resolves Fire toxicity
Disperses Wind and Dampness
Opens the nasal passages
Clears Excess Heat from the Lungs
Clears Blazing Stomach Fire
SYNDROMES
Stagnation of Heat in the Lungs and Stomach
CLINICAL MANIFESTATIONS
Yellowish, turbid nasal discharge
Frontal headache
Foul breath
Constant stuffy nose
Mouth breathing during sleep
T: Red
C: Yellowish
P: Wiry and rapid
TREATS
Sinusitis

LIQUID STYRAX PILL
English:
Liquid Styrax Pill
Also Known As:
Styrax Formula
Styrax Pill
Su He Xiang Pills
sections.ACTIONS:
Styrax
Su He Xiang
2-15g
Opens the Orifices, penetrates turbidity, breaks up Stagnation, clears filth and relieves pain.
With An Xi Xiang , penetrates turbidity around the Orifices, opens closed disorders and restores consciousness.
With Bing Pian, Ru Xiang and Tan Xiang, for angina pectoris.
With She Xiang, Bing Pian and Zhu Sha, for sudden unconsciousness or Cold-type Closed disorders.
With Chen Xiang, Ding Xiang, Tan Xiang and Xiang Fu, for chest and abdominal pain.
Moschus
She Xiang
.2-.60g
Strongly opens the Orifices and Luo vessels, revives the Shen and unblocks closed disorders.
With Bing Pian , for convulsions, loss of consciousness and coma due to extreme Heat or Phlegm Blocking the Orifices.
With Su He Xiang, revives closed patterns of Wind-Stroke or Phlegm Collapse
With Su He Xiang and An Xi Xiang, for Cold closed disorders usually due to Cold-Dampness or Phlegm-Turbidity.
With Su He Xiang and Xie Xiang, for Impaired consciousness due to Cold and Phlegm.
Borneolum
Bing Pian
.5-30g
Aromatically opens Orifices, revives the Spirit and unblocks closed disorders .
With Su He Xiang, She Xiang and An Xi Xiang, for Cold closed disorders.
With Su He Xiang and She Xiang, for convulsions due to Cold.
Benzoinum
An Xi Xiang
3-60g
Opens the Orifices, resolves Phlegm, moves Qi, activates Blood and alleviates pain.
With She Xiang, Ding Xiang and Su He Xiang , for sudden coma, chest pain, or seizures in cases with Phlegm and Qi Obstruction.
With Su He Xiang, for Wind-Stroke from Damp-Cold and turbid Phlegm.

4-60g
Regulates Qi and a lleviates pain .
With Tan Xiang, Chen Xiang, Ru Xiang, Ding Xiang and Xiang Fu , promotes Qi circulation, descends Qi , removes Qi Stagnation, dispels Cold and transforms turbidity.
With Bai Zhu, for anorexia with epigastric and abdominal pain and distention.
Lignum Santali Albi
Tan Xiang
3-60g
Moves Qi, harmonizes the Middle Jiao, dispels Cold and a lleviates pain .
With Mu Xiang and Ding Xiang, for chest, epigastric, and abdominal pain due to stagnant Qi due to Cold.
With Xiang Fu, regulates Qi and harmonizes the Liver and Spleen to treat Liver QI Stagnation causing Spleen and Stomach disharmony with a stifling sensation in the chest and flanks, belching, sighing, loss of appetite and epigastric pain.
Lignum Aquilariae Resinatum
Chen Xiang
1-60g
Moves and descends Qi, regulates the Middle, warms the Spleen, Stomach and Kidneys, stops vomiting and alleviates pain.
With Mu Xiang , relieves pain and treats Rebellious Middle Jiao Qi with belching, hiccup, nausea and vomiting, epigastric and abdominal distention stifling sensation in the epigastrium and diarrhea.
Olibanum
Ru Xiang
2-30g
Moves Qi and invigorates the Blood.
Flos Caryophylli
Ding Xiang
1-60g
Warms the Middle Jiao, descends Qi and relieves pain.
With Bai Zhu , for Spleen Qi Deficiency.
Rz. Cyperi
Xiang Fu
4-60g
Regulates Liver Qi .
Fr. Piperis Longi
Bi Ba
3-60g
Warms the Middle Jiao , descends Qi, disperses Stomach and Intestinal Cold and stops pain.
With Su He Xiang and An Xi Xiang, for severe attacks of Cold-Dampness and turbid Phlegm.

Xi Jiao
.5-60g
Relieves toxicity and calms the Shen - Endangered species, no longer used.
(Cornu Bubali)
(Shui Niu Jiao)
4-200g
(Clears Heat from the Ying and Xue s tages, r elieves Fire toxicity and c ools the Blood - Substitutes for Xi Jiao.)

HERB FORMULAS
TIAN MA GOU TENG YIN -
天麻芶藤飲 - GASTRODIA AND UNCARIA DECOCTION
English:
Gastrodia and Uncaria Decoction
Also Known As:
sections.ACTIONS:
Rz. Gastrodiae
Tian Ma
6-9g
Extinguishes Wind, calms the Liver, stops spasms and tremors and subdues rising Liver Yang .
With Gou Teng and Shi Jue Ming , calms the Liver and extinguishes Wind.
Ram. Uncariae cum Uncis
Gou Teng
6-15g
Extinguishes Wind, stops spasms, drains Liver Heat and pacifies Liver Yang .
With Tian Ma, calms the Liver and extinguishes Wind.
Concha Haliotidis
Shi Jue Ming
3-24g
Drains Fire, descends Yang and calms internal Wind.
Fr. Gardeniae
Zhi Zi
3-9g
Clears Heat and cools and activates Blood.
With Huang Qin , clears Heat and drains Fire preventing Heat from rising through the Liver channel.
Rx. Scutellariae
Huang Qin
6-9g
Drains Fire and calms ascending Liver Yang .
With Zhi Zi, powerfully clears and drains lurking Heat from the Lungs with fever, fullness in the chest, cough with yellow sputum and epistaxis or hematemesis.
Hb. Leonuri
Yi Mu Cao
6-12g
Invigorates the Blood preventing Blood from rising to the head with rising Liver Yang .
Rx. Cyathulae
Chuan Niu Xi
6-12g
Invigorates and descends Blood and expels Wind .
With Du Zhong and Sang Ji Sheng , tonifies and nourishes the Liver and Kidneys.
Cx. Eucommiae
Du Zhong
6-12g
Tonifies the Kidneys and Liver, aids the smooth flow of Qi and Blood and lowers Blood pressure.
Hb. Taxilli
Sang Ji Sheng
6-24g
Nourishes Liver and Kidney Yin , nourishes Blood and treats hypertension.
Caul. Polygoni Multiflori
Ye Jiao Teng
6-30g
Nourishes Heart Yin , nourishes Blood, calms the Shen and unblocks the channels .
With Fu Shen , calms the Shen and steadies the will.
Poria Pararadicis
Fu Shen
3-15g
Pacifies the Heart, calms the Shen and soothes the nerves.
FORMULA ACTIONS
Calms the Liver
Extinguishes Wind
Clears Heat
Invigorates the Blood
Tonifies the Liver and Kidneys
SYNDROMES
Liver Wind Stirring Internally: Liver Yang (Liver Fire)
Generates Wind
Liver Yin Deficiency with Liver Yang Rising

HERB FORMULAS
TIAN TAI WU YAO SAN -
天臺烏藥散 - TOP QUALITY LINDERA POWDER
English:
Top Quality Lindera Powder
Also Known As:
The Lindera Root Powder
sections.ACTIONS:
Rx. Linderae
Wu Yao
5-15g
Moves Qi , disperses stagnant Liver Qi , warms the Kidneys, disperses Cold and alleviates pain.
With Xiao Hui Xiang, Mu Xiang Qing Pi and Gao Liang Jiang, for Cold-type hernia with lower abdominal pain that radiates to the testicles.
Rx. Aucklandiae
Mu Xiang
5-15g
Moves Qi , alleviates pain, strengthens the Spleen, p revents Stagnation and adjusts and regulates Intestinal Qi .
With Qing Pi , for abdominal pain, distention and belching.
With Xiao Hui Xiang, Qing Pi and Gao Liang Jiang , strengthens the actions of Wu Yao.
With Bing Lang, for Qi Stagnation in the Stomach and Intestines due to Food Stagnation with abdominal distention, and fullness and distention, anorexia, aversion to the smell of food, nausea without the ability to vomit and an uncomfortable urge to defecate which is often unsuccessful, Intestinal parasites with a pressing pain around the umbilicus and intermittent focal distention in the abdomen
and relieves tenesmus and the passage of mucus in dysenteric disorders.
With Wu Yao, for lower abdominal Coldness and pain.
Dry-fried Fr. Foeniculi
Xiao Hui Xiang
5-15g
Warms the Lower Jiao , disperses Cold, spreads Liver Qi, h armonizes the Stomach and alleviates pain.
With Chuan Lian Zi, strongly stops pain and regulates Qi to treat bulging disorders and mobile masses in the lower abdomen.
Per. Citri Reticulatae Viride
Qing Pi
5-15g
Regulates Qi , disperses stagnant Liver Qi, dissipates accumulations, r educes Food Stagnation , dries Dampness and t ransforms Phlegm .
With Wu Yao, Gao Liang Jiang, Xiao Hui Xiang and Mu Xiang , for Cold Invading the Liver channel, with lower abdominal pain radiating down to the testicles or ovaries.
With Wu Yao, Chuan Lian Zi, Xiao Hui Xiang, Bing Lang and Mu Xiang , for
Intestinal prolapse, feeling of genital prolapse or testicular swelling due to chronic orchitis.
Rz. Alpiniae Officinari
Gao Liang Jiang
5-15g
Disperses Cold and alleviates pain.
With Xiao Huo Xiang, for abdominal hernial pain.
Sm. Arecae
Bing Lang
5-15g
Descends Qi , removes stagnation, u nblocks the bowels, relieves nausea and breaks up obstructions in the Lower Jiao .
With Mu Xiang and Qing Pi, for Food Accumulation and Qi Stagnation.
Fr. Toosendan
Chuan Lian Zi
5-15g
Regulates Qi and alleviates pain.
Prepared with Ba Dou , soothes the Liver, while its bitter, Cold properties are greatly diminished.
Sm. Crotonis
Ba Dou
5-15g
Used to prepare Chuan Lian Zi and then discarded.
FORMULA ACTIONS
Promotes Qi movement
Spreads Liver Qi
Scatters Cold
Alleviates pain
SYNDROMES
Hernia due to Small Intestine Qi Pain
Hernia due to Cold Stagnation in the Liver Channel
CLINICAL MANIFESTATIONS
Lower abdominal pain radiating to the testicles
May be localized sensation of Cold
Menstrual pain and hardness
Hypochondriac pain
Abdominal pain
Mobile abdominal masses
Swollen or distended testicles
Flank pain
Leukorrhea
T: Pale
C: White
P: Deep and slow or Wiry and tight
TREATS
Hernia
Inguinal hernia
Scrotal hernia
Epididymitis
Irritable bowel syndrome
Gastritis
Intestinal obstruction
Endometriosis
Infertility
Low back pain
Colitis
Pelvic inflammatory disease
Hernia of the Small Intestine
Vaginal or testicular hernia
Hypochondriac pain
Orchitis
Primary dysmenorrhea
Peptic ulcer
Prostatitis
Dysmenorrhea
Vaginal discharge
Abdominal pain
Constipation
sections.CONTRAINDICATIONS:
Contraindicated for those with Damp-Heat.
Do not take with Qi tonics.

PILL TO TONIFY THE HEART
English:
Emperor of Heaven's Special Pill to Tonify the Heart
Also Known As:
Ginseng and Zizyphus Formula
Emperor's Tea
The King's Mind Easing Tonic Pills
Celestial Emperor’s Heart Supplementing Elixir
The Heavenly King's Tonic Pills
sections.ACTIONS:
Rx. Rehmanniae
Sheng Di Huang
1.3-30g
Cools Heart Fire, clears Heat, cools the Blood and enriches Yin and Blood.
With Xuan Shen , for dry throat, irritability, a red tongue and a thready rapid pulse due to Yin Xu with Fire Flaring.
Rx. Ginseng
Ren Shen
1-9g
Tonifies Heart Qi and calms the Shen .
With Fu Ling , assists Heart Qi .
With Mai Men Dong and Wu Wei Zi , for Qi and Yin Xu .
(Rx. Codonopsis)
(Dang Shen)
(3-27g)
(Substitute for Ren Shen .)
Rx. Asparagi
Tian Men Dong
1.3-15g
Enriches the Yin and generates Fluids.
With Mai Men Dong , for Yin Xu with injured Fluids.
With Mai Men Dong and Xuan Shen , clears Xu Heat and nourishes Yin .
Rx. Ophiopogonis
Mai Men Dong
1.3-15g
Enriches the Yin and clears the Heart.
With Ren Shen and Wu Wei Zi , for exhaustion, increased Heart rate, profuse perspiration and wheezing due to severe Heart and Lung Xu .
Rx. Scrophulariae
Xuan Shen
1-20g
Enriches Yin and clears Heat.
Rx. Salviae Miltiorrhizae
Dan Shen
1.3-20g
Invigorates, cools and nourishes the Blood and clears Heat.
With Dang Gui , nourishes Blood to nourish the Heart without causing Stasis.
With Suan Zao Ren and Bai Zi Ren , for Heart Blood Xu with palpitations and insomnia.
Poria
Fu Ling
1.3-15g
Strengthens the Spleen and pacifies the Heart.
With Suan Zao Ren, Wu Wei Zi and Yuan Zhi , for palpitations and insomnia.

(Fu Shen)
(1.5-12g)

1.3-9g

With Bai Zi Ren , calms the Shen .
With Fu Shen and Suan Zao Ren , for irritability, disorientation, palpitations, anxiety and insomnia due to Heart Blood Xu .
Rx. Angelicae Sinensis
Dang Gui
1.3-9g

Fr. Schisandrae
Wu Wei Zi
1.3-12g

With Suan Zao Ren , astringes Heart Qi .

Sm. Platycladi
Bai Zi Ren
1.3-12g

Sm. Zizyphi Spinosae
Suan Zao Ren
1.3-12g
Nourishes Heart Yin , augments Liver Blood, calms the Shen and astringes sweat.
With Wu Wei Zi, prevents leakage of Heart Qi .
Rx. Platycodi
Jie Geng
1.3-9g
Directs actions of the formula upwards.
Cinnabaris
Zhu Sha
1-3g
Sedates the Heart and anchors and calms the Shen .
With S uan Zao Ren, Bai Zi Ren and Dang Gui, for insomnia or palpitations with anxiety due to Blood Xu.

Di Yu
9g
Cools the Blood and stops bleeding .

Chuan Xiong

With Dang Gui, for Blood Deficiency causing menstrual problems including dysmenorrhea, scanty menses and amenorrhea.
